gro-au.label: VET Student Loans Program
gro-au.definition: The VET Student Loans (VSL) program, designed to support eligible students to access higher level vocational education and training and provide integrity and balance provider risk against performance outcomes to promote delivery, and access to, quality and affordable training for students.

gro-au.label: Eligible Student Role
gro-au.definition: A role held by students who meet the eligibility criteria for the VET Student Loans program.

gro-au.label: Registered Training Organisation
gro-au.definition: An organisation registered as a training provider under the applicable Australian regulatory scheme.

gro-au.label: Approved Course Deliverer Role
gro-au.definition: A role held by a third party that is already an approved course deliverer under the relevant legislation.

gro-au.label: Course Fee Loan
gro-au.definition: Loan amounts for course fees paid directly to the provider

gro-au.label: Course Provider Requirements
gro-au.definition: The set of requirements that providers must continue to meet after their approval under the VET Student Loans program.

gro-au.label: Approved Provider
gro-au.definition: An approved provider is a Registered Training Organisation (RTO) that has applied to the department to be an approved VSL course provider and has met all the provider suitability requirements.

gro-au.label: Key Legislation
gro-au.definition: Key Commonwealth and state and territory legislation as referenced in Appendix A.

gro-au.label: Approved Course Provider Role
gro-au.definition: The role of an approved course provider under the VET Student Loans program, authorized to set tuition fees and receive capped loan amounts.

gro-au.label: Previous Government-Funded VET
gro-au.definition: Previous vocational education and training for which the Commonwealth, a state or territory provided funding.

gro-au.label: Applicant
gro-au.definition: An individual or organisation applying to become an approved provider under the relevant regulatory framework.

gro-au.label: Provider Suitability Requirements
gro-au.definition: The set of requirements that an applicant must meet to be considered suitable as an approved provider.

gro-au.label: Fit and Proper Person
gro-au.definition: A standard requiring that an applicant be assessed as a fit and proper person under Sections 15–20 of the Rules.

gro-au.label: Confirmation
gro-au.definition: A formal confirmation required to be provided by an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: Listed Course Provider
gro-au.definition: A registered training organisation that is a Table A or Table B provider under HESA, a TAFE established under state or territory legislation, or a training organisation owned by the Commonwealth, state, or territory, or a body specified in the Rules.

gro-au.label: Information Required from Applicant
gro-au.definition: Certain information that an applicant is required to provide under the regulatory scheme.

gro-au.label: Provider
gro-au.definition: An education provider receiving Commonwealth payments and responsible for recovering outstanding tuition fees.

gro-au.label: Approval
gro-au.definition: The regulatory approval granted to a provider.

gro-au.label: Ongoing Requirements and Conditions
gro-au.definition: The set of ongoing requirements and conditions of approval that an approved provider must meet.

gro-au.label: Regulatory Authority Agent
gro-au.definition: An agent acting as a regulatory authority within the Australian jurisdiction.

gro-au.label: Document
gro-au.definition: A written or printed paper or electronic record that provides information or evidence.

gro-au.label: Application Process
gro-au.definition: A series of actions or steps taken in order to apply for something.

gro-au.label: Application Fee
gro-au.definition: A fee payable upon application to become an approved provider, assisting with cost recovery for processing and assessment.

gro-au.label: Certificate of Currency
gro-au.definition: A certificate of currency for workers compensation and public liability insurance.

gro-au.label: Application Form Section
gro-au.definition: A section of an application form that requests information relevant to suitability for approval as a VSL course provider.

gro-au.label: VSL Course Provider Role
gro-au.definition: The role of an entity approved as a VSL course provider under the relevant legislation.

gro-au.label: Statutory Declaration
gro-au.definition: A formal legal document required to demonstrate that an entity is a fit and proper person to be approved as a VSL course provider, and to provide additional information not captured elsewhere in the Application Form.

gro-au.label: Information Resource
gro-au.definition: A resource consisting of information required to be provided under the Standards for Registered Training Organisations (RTOs) 2025.

gro-au.label: Word and Document Limits
gro-au.definition: there is no immediate benefit to the person, as the person would still be required to complete the course to obtain the benefit; the benefits would not be a replacement for the course of study; the monetary value of the benefit is unlikely to induce a student to enrol in a course.

gro-au.label: Conditions of Approval
gro-au.definition: The set of conditions attached to an approved provider's approval.

gro-au.label: Provider Fee Limit
gro-au.definition: A provider fee limit is a maximum dollar amount for VET Student Loans that can be paid to a provider for a particular period for approved VSL courses.

gro-au.label: Period of Approval
gro-au.definition: The period for which a provider is approved will be specified in the approval notice. The period of approval is not more than 7 years.

gro-au.label: Capped Loan Amount
gro-au.definition: A funding allocation representing the capped loan amount for VET Student Loans, indexed annually, which may differ from tuition fees charged by an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: Unit Census Day
gro-au.definition: A temporal condition based on the census day of a unit of study, used to determine which fee limit period applies.

gro-au.label: VSL Funding Allocation
gro-au.definition: A funding allocation representing the total liability a student incurs when accessing VSL for a course.

gro-au.label: Fee Limit
gro-au.definition: A financial resource representing the maximum loan amount available to cover course fees.

gro-au.label: Excess Loan Amount
gro-au.definition: Any loan amount that exceeds the provider fee limit for an approved course provider

gro-au.label: Change Approval Conditions Action
gro-au.definition: The action of applying to change the conditions of an approval held by an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: VET Student Loans Determination 2016
gro-au.definition: The VET Student Loans (Courses and Loan Caps) Determination 2016 legislative instrument.

gro-au.label: Course Delivery Outsourcing
gro-au.definition: The action of outsourcing the delivery of courses or parts of courses to a third party.

gro-au.label: Course Delivery
gro-au.definition: The delivery of courses or parts of courses that may be outsourced by an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: Delivery Responsibility
gro-au.definition: The action of carrying full responsibility for all aspects of course delivery, including adherence to regulations, quality, staffing, resources, and student welfare.

gro-au.label: Delivery Aspects
gro-au.definition: The set of aspects for which the approved course provider must carry full responsibility, including adherence to the Act and Rules, quality and standards, teaching by qualified staff, adequate resources and facilities, and adequate measures to protect student welfare.

gro-au.label: Department
gro-au.definition: The Australian Government department responsible for administering the VET Student Loans program.

gro-au.label: VSL Information
gro-au.definition: Information related to VET Student Loans that must be made available to students.

gro-au.label: Marketing Material
gro-au.definition: Promotional content used to advertise or inform about products, services, or entities.

gro-au.label: Annual Charge
gro-au.definition: A financial charge payable annually by approved providers under the VET Student Loans (Charges) Act 2016.

gro-au.label: Financial Year Approval Period
gro-au.definition: The temporal condition that the obligation applies during each financial year the provider is approved, including partial years.

gro-au.label: Funding Allocation
gro-au.definition: A monetary resource allocated under a funding provision.

gro-au.label: Large Provider Condition
gro-au.definition: A condition that applies when an approved course provider has more than 1,000 enrolments in a financial year.

gro-au.label: No Enrolment Condition
gro-au.definition: A condition that applies when an approved course provider has no enrolments in a financial year.

gro-au.label: Increased Loan Cap
gro-au.definition: A funding resource representing the increased loan cap applied to VET Student Loans for eligible students.

gro-au.label: Determination Course
gro-au.definition: A course listed in the Determination that is within an RTO's scope of registration

gro-au.label: Schedule 3 Course
gro-au.definition: A course listed in Schedule 3 of the Determination under 'Schedule 3 – Approved courses for specified providers'.

gro-au.label: Specified Provider
gro-au.definition: A provider specified in Schedule 3 of the Determination as eligible to offer approved courses.

gro-au.label: Grandfathered Student Role
gro-au.definition: A role held by a student studying in a course that has been removed from the Determination, who submitted an eCAF prior to the course's removal.

gro-au.label: Student Liability Data
gro-au.definition: Data relating to student liability that must be submitted into the Tertiary Collection of Student Information (TCSI) system.

gro-au.label: Provider Payment Report
gro-au.definition: A report detailing provider payments, available in HITS, containing eligibility assessment outcomes.

gro-au.label: Fee Period
gro-au.definition: A designated period within an approved course for which tuition fees are charged, ensuring even debt accrual for students.

gro-au.label: Loan Payment Process
gro-au.definition: The process by which the Secretary pays loan amounts to the provider.

gro-au.label: Tuition Fee Decision
gro-au.definition: The action of deciding tuition fees by an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: Non-tuition Fee
gro-au.definition: Non-tuition fees are any fees not directly related to academic suitability assessments, enrolment, tuition, examinations, or awarding qualifications.

gro-au.label: Maximum Tuition Fee
gro-au.definition: The maximum tuition fees mentioned in the marketing of a course, serving as an upper bound for estimates.

gro-au.label: Actual Total Tuition Fee
gro-au.definition: The actual total of the tuition fees for a course, which may exceed the estimate under certain conditions.

gro-au.label: Final Fee Period
gro-au.definition: The final fee period for a course during which excess tuition fees may be charged.

gro-au.label: Enrolment Information
gro-au.definition: Information about census days, tuition fees, withdrawal procedures, and other required procedures that must be provided to students prior to enrolment.

gro-au.label: Table A Provider
gro-au.definition: A higher education provider listed at subsection 16-15(1) of the Higher Education Support Act 2003 (HESA).

gro-au.label: Goods and Services
gro-au.definition: Goods and services that must not be included in tuition fees, such as course materials and professional equipment.

gro-au.label: Clinic/Lab/Workshop Materials
gro-au.definition: Clinic, laboratory or workshop materials such as anaesthetics, chemicals, filters, fuel, fertilisers, animal feed or crops used in practical sessions or research

gro-au.label: Tuition Fee Covered Goods and Services
gro-au.definition: Goods and services which may be covered by tuition fees include large items of equipment, access to library books, examinations or assessments, clinic materials, re-assessment of results, access to computers, mailing charges, application or enrolment fees, and course notes. This does not include reassessment where reassessment occurs through the student re-enrolling in the subject or VET unit of study after failing it.

gro-au.label: Alternative Access Resource
gro-au.definition: Alternative forms of access to goods or services essential to the course, where the provider also provides readily available access in another form at no additional cost to students.

gro-au.label: Graduation Ceremony
gro-au.definition: A graduation ceremony where students are not required to attend to obtain their award

gro-au.label: Reading Material
gro-au.definition: Reading material, such as anthologies of required readings, provided these texts are also made readily available free of charge.

gro-au.label: Unnecessary Cost
gro-au.definition: Costs for content that is not necessary or relevant to the qualification.

gro-au.label: Statement of Covered Fees
gro-au.definition: A written statement provided to a student indicating whether the provider accepts or does not accept their enrolment on the basis that all or part of their tuition fees will be covered by a VET Student Loan.

gro-au.label: Gap Fee
gro-au.definition: A tuition fee for a course includes the maximum amount covered by a VET Student Loan and the remaining tuition cost not covered by the loan – the ‘gap fee’. As it’s part of the tuition fee, the gap fee can’t include fees for non-tuition services such as items and equipment that become the student’s physical property and are not consumed in the course (for example, maps, charts or textbooks).

gro-au.label: Tuition Fee Benefit
gro-au.definition: Bursaries, scholarships, or other forms of tuition fee discounts or subsidies offered to students.

gro-au.label: Compliance Information
gro-au.definition: Information regarding how a scholarship and/or bursary complies with the Act

gro-au.label: Government Department
gro-au.definition: A department of the Australian Government

gro-au.label: RPL Fee
gro-au.definition: A fee for Recognition of Prior Learning covered by VET Student Loans and other tuition fees.

gro-au.label: State/Territory Subsidy Arrangement
gro-au.definition: A condition where compliance with state or territory subsidy funding arrangements applies.

gro-au.label: Administrative Error Correction
gro-au.definition: A condition where a change is made to correct an administrative error.

gro-au.label: Change in Circumstances
gro-au.definition: A condition where a change is made to deal with a change in circumstances.

gro-au.label: No Disadvantage to Students
gro-au.definition: A condition where a change does not disadvantage students enrolled in or seeking to enrol in a course.

gro-au.label: Census Day Constraint
gro-au.definition: A temporal condition that the change occurs on or before the census day.

gro-au.label: HITS
gro-au.definition: The HITS (Higher Information Technology System) platform used for uploading requests and managing provider interactions.

gro-au.label: Secretary
gro-au.definition: The Secretary who holds regulatory authority to approve requests under the relevant legislation.

gro-au.label: Course Part
gro-au.definition: A component or segment of a course

gro-au.label: Change Fee Period Length
gro-au.definition: The action of modifying the length of fee periods that have not yet commenced.

gro-au.label: Secretary Role
gro-au.definition: The role of the Secretary as a regulatory authority under the relevant Australian legislation.

gro-au.label: Written Notice
gro-au.definition: A written notice submitted by an approved course provider to the Secretary regarding non-compliance with fee period requirements.

gro-au.label: Online Enquiry Form
gro-au.definition: The online enquiry form on Provider Enquiries used as a submission channel for written notices.

gro-au.label: Student Documentary Evidence Process
gro-au.definition: Processes and procedures for collecting and verifying student documentary evidence.

gro-au.label: Application and Enrolment Records
gro-au.definition: Required records for the application and enrolment process as specified in part 45.

gro-au.label: Merit-Based Decision Procedure
gro-au.definition: Open, fair and transparent procedures that are reasonably believed to be based on merit for making decisions.

gro-au.label: Employer or Industry Body
gro-au.definition: An employer or industry body that may enter into enrolment arrangements with an approved course provider.

gro-au.label: Enrolment Arrangement
gro-au.definition: An arrangement between an approved course provider and an employer or industry body that limits or restricts enrolments in some or all places in an approved course.

gro-au.label: Student Role
gro-au.definition: The role of a student enrolled in an educational institution, eligible for HELP loan re-borrowing.

gro-au.label: Academically Suitable
gro-au.definition: Determining whether the student is academically suitable The course provider decides whether the student is academically suited to the course they're applying for. A student is academically suited to a course when:

gro-au.label: Assessment
gro-au.definition: An evaluation or appraisal of a student's academic suitability.

gro-au.label: Student
gro-au.definition: A person enrolled in a higher education or vocational education and training course in Australia.

gro-au.label: Evidence
gro-au.definition: Material or information presented to support a claim or requirement.

gro-au.label: Academic Suitability Evidence
gro-au.definition: Evidence required to show academic suitability, including qualifications, assessments, or overseas qualification letters.

gro-au.label: USI Transcript
gro-au.definition: An authenticated Unique Student Identifier (USI) transcript from the Student Identifiers Register.

gro-au.label: AQF Qualification
gro-au.definition: A qualification issued under the Australian Qualifications Framework or a predecessor framework.

gro-au.label: Assessment Results
gro-au.definition: The results of assessing a student's competence in reading and numeracy.

gro-au.label: Loan Cap Amount
gro-au.definition: The relevant loan cap amount for a course, determined as the indexed amount in the year of study.

gro-au.label: Determination
gro-au.definition: A regulatory instrument that sets parameters for student loans.

gro-au.label: Transferring Student Loan Cap
gro-au.definition: The remaining loan cap available to a student who transfers to another provider and continues to study the same course. The loan cap does not reset; the student can only access a VET Student Loan up to the remainder of the total loan cap.

gro-au.label: VET Student Loan Fee Notice
gro-au.definition: A notice issued to a student detailing fees associated with a VET Student Loan.

gro-au.label: Financial Resource
gro-au.definition: A resource representing a financial asset or balance, such as a HELP balance recredit

gro-au.label: VETSL Debt
gro-au.definition: A debt incurred under the VET Student Loan scheme, calculated as the tuition fee plus a 20% loan fee.

gro-au.label: HELP Balance Reduction
gro-au.definition: The action of reducing a student's HELP balance by the tuition fee amount when a VET Student Loan is accessed.

gro-au.label: HELP Loan Limit
gro-au.definition: A maximum amount that a person can borrow over their lifetime for VSL, VET FEE-HELP, FEE-HELP and HECS-HELP.

gro-au.label: HELP Repayment Re-borrowable Amount
gro-au.definition: A funding allocation representing the amount of compulsory or voluntary HELP loan repayments that becomes available for re-borrowing, up to the HELP loan limit.

gro-au.label: HELP Balance
gro-au.definition: The remaining amount a student can borrow under the Higher Education Loan Program, calculated as the HELP loan limit minus used amounts.

gro-au.label: HELP Balance Payment
gro-au.definition: A payment made by the Commonwealth under a VET Student Loan, FEE-HELP, or HECS-HELP scheme, capped by the student's available HELP balance.

gro-au.label: Commonwealth
gro-au.definition: The Commonwealth of Australia acting as a regulatory authority.

gro-au.label: Withdrawal and Deferral Process
gro-au.definition: Processes established by an approved course provider to manage student withdrawal from or deferral of their course.

gro-au.label: Regulatory Authority Role
gro-au.definition: A role held by an agent that exercises regulatory authority within the Australian jurisdiction.

gro-au.label: Fee Notice
gro-au.definition: A document providing details of fees payable by a student, as required under Australian education regulations.

gro-au.label: Commonwealth Assistance Notice
gro-au.definition: A document detailing Commonwealth assistance provided to a student, as required under Australian education regulations.

gro-au.label: Withdrawal Confirmation Mechanism
gro-au.definition: A way to confirm receipt of the student's withdrawal, including the date and time of the student's withdrawal, the unit(s) of study they withdrew from and the relevant census day, and a way to inform the student whether they have incurred a debt for the unit(s) they withdrew from.

gro-au.label: Education Provider Role
gro-au.definition: The role of an education provider responsible for confirming student withdrawal and informing about debt.

gro-au.label: Disincentive Fee
gro-au.definition: Any fee that would act as a disincentive to a student withdrawing on or before the census day.

gro-au.label: Tuition Fee Loan Refund
gro-au.definition: Gap fees or tuition fees paid through a loan from the provider that must be refunded.

gro-au.label: VET Student Loan Condition
gro-au.definition: A condition where a student has a VET Student loan for any part of the fees for a course.

gro-au.label: Cancellation Fee
gro-au.definition: A fee charged for cancelling the enrolment of a student.

gro-au.label: Progression Form
gro-au.definition: A form used to record a student's withdrawal, deferral, or recommencement of study for VET Student Loans purposes.

gro-au.label: Course Data
gro-au.definition: Information on approved courses, including unit of study outcomes and course outcomes submissions detailing students' completion, withdrawal or deferments of courses and parts of courses.

gro-au.label: Course
gro-au.definition: A program of study offered by an educational provider.

gro-au.label: Course Requirement
gro-au.definition: A requirement that must be satisfied for successful completion of a course.

gro-au.label: Assessment Activity
gro-au.definition: An activity designed to evaluate a student's knowledge or skills.

gro-au.label: Online Course Login
gro-au.definition: An occasion on which a student logs into an online course platform.

gro-au.label: Correct Processes Resource
gro-au.definition: The correct processes specified in part 40.5 for cancelling a student's enrolment after the census day.

gro-au.label: Cancellation After Census Day Condition
gro-au.definition: The condition that the provider cancels a student's enrolment for any reason after the census day.

gro-au.label: VSL Approved Course
gro-au.definition: A course approved for VET Student Loans.

gro-au.label: International Student Role
gro-au.definition: The role of a student who is an international student and clearly not eligible for VET Student Loans.

gro-au.label: Upfront Tuition Payment
gro-au.definition: An upfront payment made by a student towards tuition fees.

gro-au.label: Student Withdrawal
gro-au.definition: The process of a student withdrawing from an approved course.

gro-au.label: Course Information
gro-au.definition: A collection of information items that must be provided to students, including course name, part name, identifying code, census day, tuition fees, VSL coverage, and VSL debt amount.

gro-au.label: Issued Email Address Exclusion
gro-au.definition: An email address you have issued to the student is not considered the student’s personal email address.

gro-au.label: Accessible Defined Term
gro-au.definition: accessible means you have informed the student the information or document is to be given using the system, and have authorised the student to use the system

gro-au.label: VET Student Loan Application
gro-au.definition: An application or assessment task that a student is required to complete for the purposes of determining academic suitability for an approved course under the VET Student Loans program.

gro-au.label: Student Information Handling Process
gro-au.definition: Processes and procedures for handling student information, including management of personal information in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles.

gro-au.label: Loan Amount Repayment
gro-au.definition: The action of repaying a loan amount that was used to pay tuition fees for a student's course.

gro-au.label: Student Withdrawal or Deferral
gro-au.definition: The condition where a student withdraws or defers before census day, triggering a HELP balance recredit.

gro-au.label: Overpayment Amount
gro-au.definition: An amount equal to any amount that was paid to a provider but was not payable, such as erroneous payments or payments based on false information.

gro-au.label: Government Body
gro-au.definition: An organisation that is part of the government structure, such as a department or agency.

gro-au.label: Secretary of the Department
gro-au.definition: The Secretary of the Australian Government department responsible for administering the HELP scheme.

gro-au.label: Department Secretary Role
gro-au.definition: The role of the Secretary of the department.

gro-au.label: Unacceptable Conduct Condition
gro-au.definition: A condition where a student has been subject to unacceptable conduct as defined in part 48.4.

gro-au.label: Recredited Amount
gro-au.definition: The amount the Secretary recredits, which must equal the loan amount used to pay tuition fees for the student for the relevant part of the course.

gro-au.label: Impracticable
gro-au.definition: ‘Impracticable’ means ‘not practicable – that which cannot be put into practice with the available resources’.

gro-au.label: Medical Circumstances
gro-au.definition: medical circumstances – for example, where the student’s medical condition has changed so much that they’re unable to continue studying

gro-au.label: Family or Personal Circumstances
gro-au.definition: family or personal circumstances – for example, death or severe medical problems in the student’s family, or unforeseen financial difficulties which affect the student so much that it’s unreasonable to expect them to continue studying

gro-au.label: Affected Person
gro-au.definition: A person affected by a reviewable decision under Australian regulatory provisions.

gro-au.label: Reviewable Decision
gro-au.definition: A reviewable decision under the Act – that is, a decision about recrediting a student’s HELP balance for special circumstances

gro-au.label: Administrative Review Tribunal
gro-au.definition: The Administrative Review Tribunal (ART) as an organisation that conducts reviews of decisions.

gro-au.label: Decision Maker
gro-au.definition: A role responsible for making decisions that may be subject to review.

gro-au.label: HELP Balance Recredit Review
gro-au.definition: The process of reviewing a provider's decision not to recredit a student's HELP balance for special circumstances.

gro-au.label: HELP Balance Recredit Decision
gro-au.definition: A decision made by an educational provider regarding the re-crediting of a student's HELP balance for special circumstances.

gro-au.label: Review Officer Role
gro-au.definition: The role of a review officer who reconsiders decisions and issues written notices to students.

gro-au.label: Decision
gro-au.definition: A decision that is subject to reconsideration, confirmation, variation, or substitution.

gro-au.label: Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024 Part 10
gro-au.definition: The Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024 Part 10, which establishes the right to apply for review of decisions.

gro-au.label: Right to Apply for ART Review
gro-au.definition: The right to apply to the Administrative Review Tribunal to have a decision reviewed.

gro-au.label: Notice of Review Rights
gro-au.definition: A document that informs a student of their rights to seek review of a decision, along with the reasons for the decision or reconsideration.

gro-au.label: Grievance Procedure
gro-au.definition: A documented procedure for handling complaints from students regarding academic and non-academic matters.

gro-au.label: Appropriate Records
gro-au.definition: Records that are required to be kept in relation to the grievance procedure, as specified by the regulatory provision.

gro-au.label: Appeal Process
gro-au.definition: A process for appealing a decision to an independent senior officer of the provider, or to an internal committee or unit with appropriate expertise.

gro-au.label: Party to Procedure
gro-au.definition: A party to this stage of the procedure

gro-au.label: Accompanying Person
gro-au.definition: Another person who accompanies or assists a party

gro-au.label: Review Party
gro-au.definition: A party to a review process, as defined under Australian regulatory provisions.

gro-au.label: VET Student Loans Ombudsman
gro-au.definition: The VET Student Loans Ombudsman, an Australian regulatory authority operating an external dispute resolution process.

gro-au.label: Making a Representation
gro-au.definition: 'Making a representation' means you've used words or actions to state or suggest something.

gro-au.label: Levy Part
gro-au.definition: A portion of the levy that is calculated using a provider's validated data from previous years to reflect actual enrolments and risk.

gro-au.label: Tuition Protection Service Levy
gro-au.definition: A levy imposed on certain providers for the tuition protection service, from which exempt providers are relieved.

gro-au.label: Section 48 Procedures
gro-au.definition: The procedures set out in section 48 of the VET Student Loans Act 2016.

gro-au.label: Tax File Number
gro-au.definition: A student's Tax File Number, excluded from the document retention requirement.

gro-au.label: Procedure Set
gro-au.definition: A set of procedures for determining academic suitability, publishing fee information, and clarifying the VSL application process.

gro-au.label: Required Provider Role
gro-au.definition: The role of a provider required to have certain processes and procedures under Australian regulatory provisions.

gro-au.label: Student Information
gro-au.definition: Particular information that must be provided to students under the Information Provision Rules.

gro-au.label: Student Enrolment
gro-au.definition: The enrolment status of a student in a course.

gro-au.label: Student Complaints
gro-au.definition: Complaints lodged by students regarding provider services.

gro-au.label: Correspondence
gro-au.definition: All correspondence between an approved course provider and a student (or the student's parent or guardian) in relation to the course, including notices issued to the student.

gro-au.label: Marketing Merchandise
gro-au.definition: Promotional items offered by an approved course provider, subject to a per-person value limit.

gro-au.label: Third-Party Contact List
gro-au.definition: A contact list owned or controlled by a third party, used for marketing, advertising, or promotional purposes.

gro-au.label: Express Consent
gro-au.definition: A student is also taken to have provided express consent if they initiate contact with a third party for the purposes of giving information to you, or getting information from you, relating to education and training.

gro-au.label: Broker or Agent Arrangement
gro-au.definition: An arrangement with another person for that person to perform specified activities in relation to an approved course, including enrolment, VSL advice, and application assistance.

gro-au.label: VSL Student
gro-au.definition: A student who could be eligible for a VET Student Loan (VSL) for a course.

gro-au.label: Academic Suitability Assessment
gro-au.definition: The process of determining whether a student is academically suited to undertake an approved course, including any tasks the student is required to complete for that purpose.

gro-au.label: Employment Contract
gro-au.definition: A contract of employment as referenced in the exception to the prohibition.

gro-au.label: ACTAC Member
gro-au.definition: A member of the Australasian Conference of Tertiary Admission Centres.

gro-au.label: Resource
gro-au.definition: A resource as defined within the Australian regulatory context.

gro-au.label: Census Day Information
gro-au.definition: Information about census days, allowable variations, and student complaint processes.

gro-au.label: Student Data
gro-au.definition: student data – information on student enrolments, and the personal details of students approved for a loan

gro-au.label: Debt Report
gro-au.definition: A report of debt amounts submitted in a given month.

gro-au.label: Information or Document
gro-au.definition: A resource that is either information or a document, as referenced in regulatory provisions.

gro-au.label: Staff Commission Payment
gro-au.definition: The act of paying staff commissions, benefits, or bonuses connected to student enrolment numbers

gro-au.label: Staff Commission
gro-au.definition: Commissions, benefits, or bonuses paid to staff that are tied to student enrolment numbers

gro-au.label: Outcome RTO Standards
gro-au.definition: The Outcome RTO Standards referenced in the provision, including standards 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5 and 1.6.

gro-au.label: Compliance RTO Standards
gro-au.definition: The Compliance RTO Standards referenced in the provision, including sections 8-11 and schedule 1.

gro-au.label: NVR Act
gro-au.definition: The National Vocational Education and Training Regulator Act referenced in the provision, including sections 103-110.

gro-au.label: Event
gro-au.definition: An occurrence or happening, especially one of significance, that triggers a normative response.

gro-au.label: Loan Amount
gro-au.definition: A financial resource representing a previously paid loan amount under the VET Student Loans program.

gro-au.label: Third Party Arrangement
gro-au.definition: Third party arrangement—where another person or body provides services on behalf of the VSL approved provider (which may require approval under the Act [Act s 15])

gro-au.label: Provider Organisation Role
gro-au.definition: The role of an organisation that is subject to provider legislative obligations.

gro-au.label: Information
gro-au.definition: Information that must be given by approved course providers as determined by the Secretary.

gro-au.label: Provider Legislative Obligations
gro-au.definition: The set of legislative obligations that an approved course provider must comply with under Australian law.

gro-au.label: ASQA
gro-au.definition: The Australian Skills Quality Authority, the national regulator for Australia's vocational education and training sector.

gro-au.label: ACCC
gro-au.definition: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission, an independent Commonwealth statutory authority.

gro-au.label: ATO
gro-au.definition: The Australian Taxation Office, the principal revenue collection agency of the Australian Government.

gro-au.label: Checklist
gro-au.definition: Checklist for administrative requirements at Appendix P

gro-au.label: Regulatory Authority
gro-au.definition: The authority responsible for administering and enforcing the Act and Rules.

gro-au.label: Executive Officer
gro-au.definition: A role held by an individual who is an executive officer of an organisation, as defined in the Act.

gro-au.label: Penalty Unit
gro-au.definition: A monetary penalty unit as defined under Australian law.

gro-au.label: Services Australia Payment
gro-au.definition: Financial payments administered by Services Australia, including Youth Allowance, Austudy, and ABSTUDY.

gro-au.label: VSL Approved Provider
gro-au.definition: An education provider approved for the VET Student Loans (VSL) program.

gro-au.label: Student of VSL Provider
gro-au.definition: A student enrolled with an education provider that holds VSL approval.

gro-au.label: VSL Tuition Protection Director
gro-au.definition: VSL Tuition Protection Director is a statutory appointed Director to manage the VSL tuition protection arrangements.

gro-au.label: Periodic Report
gro-au.definition: A periodic report on VSL students required by the VSL Tuition Protection Director.

gro-au.label: VSL Tuition Protection Fund
gro-au.definition: A sector-specific special account established to administer the VSL tuition protection arrangements.

gro-au.label: Scenario 1 RPL Definition
gro-au.definition: Scenario 1: RPL is granted as part of the UoS. It is intended that the student will enrol in a standard UoS (or the majority of it) as negotiated with the provider. Only a small proportion of the UoS will be granted via RPL.

gro-au.label: Accumulated Debt for Course
gro-au.definition: Accumulated debt for course is an indicative cumulative debt amount accrued by the student for the VET course code, as reported by providers in TCSI. This amount may be adjusted when payment claims are validated. It may include both VET FEE-HELP and VSL accrued from 1 January 2017.

gro-au.label: External LLN Tool
gro-au.definition: An external Language, Literacy and Numeracy tool used for assessment purposes.

gro-au.label: Applicant RTO
gro-au.definition: A Registered Training Organisation that is applying for something under the regulatory framework.

gro-au.label: Assessment Procedure
gro-au.definition: Procedures for recording and reporting the results of assessments

gro-au.label: Student Entry Procedure
gro-au.definition: A published procedure specifying requirements for student academic suitability, assessment of reading and numeracy competence, and related processes.

gro-au.label: Re-crediting Processes and Procedures
gro-au.definition: Processes and procedures for explaining the re-crediting of students' HELP balances, as required by Rules s 89.

gro-au.label: Learner Protection Information
gro-au.definition: Information that relates to ensuring each learner is properly informed and protected.

gro-au.label: VET Student Loan Information
gro-au.definition: Information about VET Student Loans, including that it is a loan from the Commonwealth, the loan will remain a personal debt until repaid, the loan may reduce take-home wage or salary and borrowing capacity, and a student may wish to seek independent financial advice.

gro-au.label: Explanation
gro-au.definition: A statement or account that makes something clear, such as an explanation of tuition fee apportionment and census days.

gro-au.label: Enrolment
gro-au.definition: The process of registering or being registered as a student at an educational institution.

gro-au.label: Independent Financial Advice
gro-au.definition: Financial advice provided by an independent third party.

gro-au.label: Course Information Resource
gro-au.definition: A resource comprising tuition fees, census days, and procedures for withdrawal and cancellation of enrolment for a course.

gro-au.label: Enrolled Student
gro-au.definition: A role held by a student who is enrolled with an educational provider.

gro-au.label: Contact Details
gro-au.definition: Personal contact information of an enrolled student, such as address, phone number, or email.

gro-au.label: Particular Information
gro-au.definition: Specific information required to be provided to students before enrolment as mandated by regulation.

gro-au.label: Specified Processes and Procedures
gro-au.definition: Processes and procedures specified in Division 1, Part 7 of the Rules made under section 48 of the Act.

gro-au.label: Information Provision Rules
gro-au.definition: Rules made under subsection 50(1) (Division 3, Part 7 of the Rules) requiring providers to provide particular information to students.

gro-au.label: Information Requirement
gro-au.definition: Ongoing information requirements as set out in Division 5, Part 7 of the Rules (made under section 52).

gro-au.label: Census Day
gro-au.definition: A designated date for a course used for administrative and reporting purposes.

gro-au.label: Tertiary Admission Centre
gro-au.definition: An organisation that administers tertiary admissions processes.

gro-au.label: Non-Tuition Fees
gro-au.definition: Fees other than tuition fees that may be charged to students.

gro-au.label: Student Fee Liability Understanding Procedure
gro-au.definition: Procedures for ensuring that students understand their total liability for fees.

gro-au.label: Special Admissions Test Fee
gro-au.definition: A fee charged for a special admissions test that determines suitability for a specialist approved course.

gro-au.label: Student Enrolment Data
gro-au.definition: Data related to a student's enrolment in a unit of study, required to be reported under Australian regulatory provisions.

gro-au.label: Equivalent Full-time Study Load
gro-au.definition: Equivalent Full-time Study Load (EFTSL) is a measure of the study load based on a student undertaking a course on a full-time basis over an academic year.

gro-au.label: Unit of Study
gro-au.definition: A unit of study for which a loan amount may be claimed or reported.

gro-au.label: Unit Enrolment
gro-au.definition: The action of reporting a new unit enrolment with specific information.

gro-au.label: Reconsideration Request
gro-au.definition: An action whereby a person formally requests a review of a decision by someone not involved in the original decision-making process.

gro-au.label: Reconsideration of Decision
gro-au.definition: The process or outcome of reviewing a previous decision, as requested by an affected party.

gro-au.label: Review of Decision
gro-au.definition: A review of a decision conducted by the Administrative Review Tribunal.

gro-au.label: Reviewable VET Decision
gro-au.definition: A decision made under the VET regulatory framework that is subject to review or reconsideration.

gro-au.label: Registered Higher Education Provider
gro-au.definition: A role held by a person or organisation that is registered as a higher education provider under Australian law.

gro-au.label: Accredited Course
gro-au.definition: A course that has been accredited by the relevant Australian higher education authority.

gro-au.label: Information or Documents
gro-au.definition: Information or documents required to be provided under a notice given under subsection 53(1).

gro-au.label: Tuition Protection Director
gro-au.definition: The regulatory authority role responsible for tuition protection under the Act.

gro-au.label: Notice of Default
gro-au.definition: A notice of default or other information required to be given under section 66C of the Act.

gro-au.label: Replacement Course Information
gro-au.definition: Information about suitable replacement courses required by the VSL Tuition Protection Director.

gro-au.label: VET Officer Role
gro-au.definition: The role of a VET officer as defined in the Act.

gro-au.label: Personal Information
gro-au.definition: Personal information obtained or generated by a VET officer or disclosed under section 95.

gro-au.label: Electronic Communication Requirements
gro-au.definition: Requirements in relation to electronic communications set out in Division 1, Part 9 of the Rules.

gro-au.label: Person
gro-au.definition: A natural person under Australian law.

gro-ca.label: Student Financial Assistance
gro-ca.definition: Financial assistance available to students, limited by minimum and maximum interest free loan award amounts set by the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program and StudentAid BC, and based on federal and provincial need assessments and eligibility for non-repayable grants and bursaries.

gro-ca.label: Student Grant
gro-ca.definition: A non-repayable grant provided to students based on eligibility criteria such as income level or disability status.

gro-ca.label: Student Loan
gro-ca.definition: A repayable loan provided to students to fund their education.

gro-ca.label: Student Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of an individual enrolled in an educational program, eligible to request funding and loan rehabilitation application reviews.

gro-ca.label: Non-repayable Financial Assistance
gro-ca.definition: A category of financial assistance that does not require repayment, including grants, bursaries, and scholarships for eligible students.

gro-ca.label: Funding Program
gro-ca.definition: A program that provides financial support to eligible recipients, such as grants, bursaries, or loan repayment assistance.

gro-ca.label: Designation Eligibility Criteria
gro-ca.definition: Criteria set by StudentAid BC that institutions must meet to be designated.

gro-ca.label: Designation
gro-ca.definition: A designation granted by StudentAid BC to institutions, effective for a single program year.

gro-ca.label: Driver Training Institution
gro-ca.definition: An institution that offers driver training programs.

gro-ca.label: Motor Vehicle Act
gro-ca.definition: The Motor Vehicle Act of British Columbia.

gro-ca.label: ICBC Regulations
gro-ca.definition: Regulations issued by the Insurance Corporation of British Columbia.

gro-ca.label: Government Body
gro-ca.definition: An organisation that is part of the government structure, such as a ministry or department.

gro-ca.label: Private Act
gro-ca.definition: A Private Act of the Legislature

gro-ca.label: Legislative Authority Program
gro-ca.definition: Offering programs within legislative authority

gro-ca.label: Designated Institution
gro-ca.definition: An institution that has been formally designated under the applicable regulatory framework.

gro-ca.label: Adhere to Responsibilities
gro-ca.definition: The action of complying with and fulfilling assigned responsibilities on an ongoing basis.

gro-ca.label: Responsibilities
gro-ca.definition: A set of duties or obligations that a designated institution must adhere to.

gro-ca.label: Document
gro-ca.definition: A written, printed, or electronic record that provides information or evidence.

gro-ca.label: Tuition and Fee Policy
gro-ca.definition: A policy document governing tuition and fees charged by an institution.

gro-ca.label: Refund Policy
gro-ca.definition: A policy document governing refunds to students upon withdrawal.

gro-ca.label: Private Post-Secondary Institution
gro-ca.definition: An in-province private post-secondary institution or in-province private academic post-secondary institution in Canada.

gro-ca.label: StudentAid BC Administration Manual
gro-ca.definition: The administrative manual governing the StudentAid BC program in British Columbia, Canada.

gro-ca.label: Ministry
gro-ca.definition: The Ministry responsible for post-secondary education and student financial assistance in British Columbia, Canada.

gro-ca.label: Institution Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of an educational institution eligible to receive adaptive technology loans under PILAT.

gro-ca.label: Student Financial Assistance Information
gro-ca.definition: Information pertaining to the student financial assistance application, related documents, and repayment of loans.

gro-ca.label: Eligibility Signing Officer
gro-ca.definition: A role designated to institution officials responsible for confirming student enrolment and attendance, completing the Confirmation of Enrolment, accepting and documenting tuition payments, reporting changes to a student’s scholastic standing, and reporting changes to course load.

gro-ca.label: Institution Official
gro-ca.definition: An official of an institution who may be designated as an Eligibility Signing Officer.

gro-ca.label: Designation Agreement
gro-ca.definition: A formal agreement designating an institution for student financial assistance purposes.

gro-ca.label: Institution Risk
gro-ca.definition: Institution risk is defined according to the following three risk zones: Green (good) Above the national average, Yellow (average) Within one standard deviation below the national average, Red (poor) Below one standard deviation from the national average.

gro-ca.label: Institution
gro-ca.definition: An educational institution that offers programs eligible for student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: Remediation Evidence or Plan
gro-ca.definition: Evidence of remediation of a compliance issue or a plan outlining how the issue will be addressed.

gro-ca.label: StudentAid BC
gro-ca.definition: The provincial organisation responsible for assessing student financial need and administering student financial assistance in British Columbia, Canada.

gro-ca.label: Appeal Decision
gro-ca.definition: A decision rendered on an appeal, communicated in writing to the institution.

gro-ca.label: Aviation Program Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding allocated to students enrolled in and attending aviation programs, including commercial pilot, endorsements, and instructor rating programs.

gro-ca.label: Application
gro-ca.definition: An application for a regulatory program or benefit.

gro-ca.label: Flight Rules
gro-ca.definition: A set of aviation flight rules, such as multi-engine and instrument flight rules.

gro-ca.label: Brokered Program of Study
gro-ca.definition: A program of study where the institution provides a formal credential while another agency or institution provides the actual program of study.

gro-ca.label: Non-Traditional Program
gro-ca.definition: Online programs, blended learning, distance education, or other programs with a non-traditional form of delivery, or a combination of traditional and non-traditional delivery

gro-ca.label: Program
gro-ca.definition: An academic or career training program offered by a post-secondary institution.

gro-ca.label: StudentAid BC Eligibility Criteria
gro-ca.definition: The set of requirements that a program must meet to be eligible for StudentAid BC funding.

gro-ca.label: Co-op Education Placement
gro-ca.definition: A work-integrated learning placement that is part of a co-op education program

gro-ca.label: Exam Period
gro-ca.definition: A period designated for examinations, included in the period of study for assessment purposes.

gro-ca.label: Period of Study
gro-ca.definition: The total duration of a student's full-time study program, including exam periods and mandatory orientations, but excluding optional orientations and excessive breaks.

gro-ca.label: Study Break
gro-ca.definition: A break in full-time study, subject to duration limits and exceptions.

gro-ca.label: Year-End Break
gro-ca.definition: An extended break at the end of the academic year, permitted up to three consecutive weeks.

gro-ca.label: Mandatory Orientation
gro-ca.definition: A mandatory orientation period for international exchange programs, included in the period of study for assessment.

gro-ca.label: Optional Orientation
gro-ca.definition: An optional orientation period, not included in the period of study for assessment.

gro-ca.label: Executive Program
gro-ca.definition: Programs of study such as executive programs that are designed specifically to meet the needs of full-time members of the labour force

gro-ca.label: English Additional Language Program
gro-ca.definition: An English as an additional language program, unless taken concurrently with post-secondary studies and representing no more than 20% of program.

gro-ca.label: Post-Credential Training Period
gro-ca.definition: Periods of training required for professional licensing or accreditation after the granting of a formal credential (internship, articling, etc.).

gro-ca.label: Financial Resource
gro-ca.definition: A resource representing financial assistance, such as grants, bursaries, or scholarships.

gro-ca.label: Mandatory Fees
gro-ca.definition: Mandatory fees are costs associated with attending a post-secondary institution, or enrolment in certain programs (such as registration fee, student license, student association or Alma Mater Society fees, membership fees for overseeing bodies) and are required to be paid by all students in the institution/program. License exam fees (whether included in tuition or not) can be included in tuition if the license exam is mandatory and it is completed within the study period. Optional fees, fees that do not apply to all students and fees already included in the moderate standard of living allowance are not to be included.

gro-ca.label: Exceptional Expense
gro-ca.definition: Exceptional expenses are those that are not normally associated with attending school but are required for certain programs.

gro-ca.label: Travel Expense
gro-ca.definition: Expenses incurred for travel under StudentAid BC programs.

gro-ca.label: Part-Time Student Loan Application
gro-ca.definition: A completed application form for part-time student loans and/or in-study payment-free status, submitted to the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program.

gro-ca.label: Province
gro-ca.definition: A provincial government entity responsible for determining and monitoring student eligibility under federal regulations.

gro-ca.label: Full-Time Student Status
gro-ca.definition: A condition representing the status of being a full-time student.

gro-ca.label: Split Enrolment
gro-ca.definition: An enrolment arrangement involving multiple post-secondary institutions.

gro-ca.label: Private Vocational/Trade Institution
gro-ca.definition: A private post-secondary institution offering vocational or trade programs.

gro-ca.label: International Exchange Student
gro-ca.definition: A student classified by their post-secondary institution as being on an international exchange.

gro-ca.label: Course Load
gro-ca.definition: The set of courses or credits a student is enrolled in during a study period.

gro-ca.label: Apprenticeship Student Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of a student who is an apprentice, as referenced in StudentAid BC eligibility rules.

gro-ca.label: StudentAid BC Declaration
gro-ca.definition: The terms and conditions of the StudentAid BC Declaration that must be consented to by the student applicant and parent or spouse.

gro-ca.label: CRA Income Verification
gro-ca.definition: The Canada Revenue Agency Income Verification terms and conditions that must be consented to by the student applicant and parent or spouse.

gro-ca.label: Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement
gro-ca.definition: The Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement (MSFAA) is a legal document that governs the rights and responsibilities, with respect to the financial assistance the student will receive from B.C. and the Government of Canada.

gro-ca.label: Post-Secondary Institution
gro-ca.definition: An educational institution providing post-secondary programs, required to confirm student enrolment for funding disbursement.

gro-ca.label: Enrolment Confirmation
gro-ca.definition: The act of a post-secondary institution verifying a student's enrolment in an eligible program.

gro-ca.label: Appendix 3 Form
gro-ca.definition: A form indicating the cost of tuition, books, and fees for a post-secondary institution.

gro-ca.label: Student Financial Assistance Program
gro-ca.definition: A program providing financial assistance to students, as described in the relevant regulatory chapter.

gro-ca.label: Regulatory Authority Agent
gro-ca.definition: An agent that acts as a regulatory authority within the Canadian jurisdiction.

gro-ca.label: Adult Upgrading Grant
gro-ca.definition: A funding allocation for students enrolled in adult upgrading programs, with amounts varying by program length.

gro-ca.label: Nurses Education Bursary
gro-ca.definition: A bursary of $2,000 per year for nurses education, allocated by SABC.

gro-ca.label: Funding Allocation Resource
gro-ca.definition: A resource representing a specific funding allocation available under the Accessibility Supports Framework.

gro-ca.label: Unused Grant
gro-ca.definition: A grant amount remaining after the Government of Canada portion of a student's assessed need has been satisfied

gro-ca.label: CSG-FTDEP Grant
gro-ca.definition: Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students with Dependants.

gro-ca.label: Weekly Grant Maximum
gro-ca.definition: A weekly grant maximum determined based on the length of the program the student is attending.

gro-ca.label: BCAG-FT Award
gro-ca.definition: The BCAG-FT grant award, a financial resource provided to eligible students under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program.

gro-ca.label: BCAG-FT Weekly Grant Amount
gro-ca.definition: The weekly grant amount a student is eligible for under the BCAG-FT program, calculated based on student characteristics and income.

gro-ca.label: Study Period Weeks
gro-ca.definition: The number of weeks in a student's study period, used as a multiplier in BCAG-FT award calculation.

gro-ca.label: Eligible Occupation
gro-ca.definition: An occupation that qualifies under the eligibility criteria, involving work with children or in an eligible underserved community.

gro-ca.label: Eligible Underserved Community
gro-ca.definition: A community designated as underserved for the purposes of eligibility criteria.

gro-ca.label: Nurses Education Bursary Budget
gro-ca.definition: The annual budget for the Nurses Education Bursary (NEB) program, allocated to eligible nursing students in British Columbia.

gro-ca.label: Eligible Nursing Student
gro-ca.definition: A student enrolled full-time in an eligible nursing program at a StudentAid BC designated post-secondary institution, with the program leading to a certificate, diploma or degree recognized for nursing practice in British Columbia.

gro-ca.label: Learning for Future Grant
gro-ca.definition: An annual grant of $3,500 per program year to assist with additional education related costs not covered by the Provincial Tuition Waiver Program.

gro-ca.label: ASF Program Eligibility
gro-ca.definition: Eligibility for ASF programs covering all years of post-secondary studies, including those beyond the undergraduate level, conditional on meeting other student financial assistance eligibility criteria.

gro-ca.label: ASF Program
gro-ca.definition: A program under the Canada Student Financial Assistance framework for which students may apply.

gro-ca.label: Appendix 8 - Disability Programs Application
gro-ca.definition: The Appendix 8 form required for students applying for ASF disability programs.

gro-ca.label: ASF Program Applicant
gro-ca.definition: A student who is applying for ASF programs.

gro-ca.label: Medical Assessor Documentation
gro-ca.definition: Documentation provided by a qualified medical assessor, signed and dated within the last three years, or a psycho-educational assessment dated within the last five years or conducted after age 18.

gro-ca.label: Financial Assistance Program
gro-ca.definition: Financial assistance programs intended to provide students with accessibility challenges with additional financial resources to address related costs associated with post-secondary education including education and living-related expenses.

gro-ca.label: Grant Funding
gro-ca.definition: Financial resource representing grant funding awarded under the BCAG-DS program.

gro-ca.label: Notice of Assessment
gro-ca.definition: An official document issued to a student confirming their assessed financial need and eligibility for student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: Bursary
gro-ca.definition: Non-repayable awards based on financial need and given to students by post-secondary institutions, governments, businesses, societies or other agencies and organizations.

gro-ca.label: Disability Verification
gro-ca.definition: Documentation submitted by a student to verify a permanent, persistent, or prolonged disability for bursary eligibility.

gro-ca.label: Student Funding Recipient
gro-ca.definition: A student who obtains funding for assistive services or reimbursement for previously purchased assistive services

gro-ca.label: Receipt Verifying Service Delivery
gro-ca.definition: A receipt that verifies the delivery of assistive services

gro-ca.label: Applicant with Multiple Disabilities
gro-ca.definition: An applicant being verified for multiple disabilities under Canadian regulations.

gro-ca.label: Reimbursement of Assessment Costs
gro-ca.definition: Reimbursement of assessment costs associated with each disability for applicants verified for multiple disabilities.

gro-ca.label: Applicant
gro-ca.definition: A role representing an individual or entity that applies for something, such as reimbursement.

gro-ca.label: Reimbursement Application
gro-ca.definition: The action of applying for reimbursement.

gro-ca.label: Reimbursement for Previously Verified Condition
gro-ca.definition: A resource representing reimbursement sought for a condition that has been previously verified.

gro-ca.label: Same Loan Year Condition
gro-ca.definition: A condition specifying that the action occurs within the same loan year.

gro-ca.label: Reimbursement Applicant
gro-ca.definition: An applicant seeking reimbursement for assessment costs under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program.

gro-ca.label: Assessment
gro-ca.definition: An assessment conducted to determine eligibility or functional limitations.

gro-ca.label: Accessibility Supports Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding allocated under the Accessibility Supports Framework, including bursaries, assistive technology, and accessibility services for students and institutions based on need.

gro-ca.label: APSD Student Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of a student eligible for the Accessibility Program for Students with Disabilities (APSD) funding in Canada.

gro-ca.label: ABE Student
gro-ca.definition: A student studying at the Adult Basic Education (ABE) level in British Columbia

gro-ca.label: APSD Application Form
gro-ca.definition: The B.C. Assistance Program for Students with Disabilities application form

gro-ca.label: Accessibility Coordinator Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of Accessibility Coordinator at a B.C. public post-secondary institution

gro-ca.label: Public Post-Secondary Loan Program
gro-ca.definition: The Public Post-Secondary Loan Program (PPL) provides for the loan of assistive technology to students with accessibility challenges.

gro-ca.label: Assistive Technology
gro-ca.definition: Assistive technology equipment loaned under the PPL program.

gro-ca.label: Student with Accessibility Challenges
gro-ca.definition: A student who has accessibility challenges and may be eligible for assistive technology loans.

gro-ca.label: Appendix 8
gro-ca.definition: A form with supporting medical documentation.

gro-ca.label: Student Support Services
gro-ca.definition: Assistive services (tutors, interpreters, academic planning), accommodation services (exam writing), and access to and administration of student financial assistance (grants, bursaries) provided under a centralized institution support program.

gro-ca.label: PILAT Funding
gro-ca.definition: A funding allocation program that provides adaptive technology loans to institutions to support student access to assistive technology.

gro-ca.label: Borrower
gro-ca.definition: An individual who is or was a student and who is receiving, or who has received, British Columbia Student Financial Assistance, Canada Student Financial Assistance, or Student Financial Assistance as outlined in the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement, to attend studies at a Designated Post-Secondary Institution.

gro-ca.label: Severe Permanent Disability Benefit
gro-ca.definition: A benefit for borrowers with a severe permanent disability that prevents substantially gainful labour force participation.

gro-ca.label: Assessed Financial Need
gro-ca.definition: The assessed financial need of a student, calculated as allowable costs minus contributions minus resources, which determines the amount of Canada-B.C. integrated student loan and grant funding a student is eligible to receive.

gro-ca.label: Canada-B.C. Integrated Student Loan and Grant Funding
gro-ca.definition: The amount of Canada-B.C. integrated student loan and grant funding that students are eligible to receive, based on their assessed financial need.

gro-ca.label: Student Dependency Differentiation
gro-ca.definition: To differentiate between those students considered to be dependent on a financial sponsor (e.g., parents or guardians) and those considered to be independent of a financial sponsor.

gro-ca.label: Independent Student
gro-ca.definition: An independent student applying for part-time funding who will be categorized as independent single, married/common-law, or single parent depending on which criteria are met.

gro-ca.label: Single-Parent Student Status
gro-ca.definition: A status designating a student as a single parent for the purposes of eligibility under Canadian regulations.

gro-ca.label: Dependent Student
gro-ca.definition: A student who would normally be considered a dependent student for financial aid purposes.

gro-ca.label: Modified Independent Student
gro-ca.definition: A student who may be considered a 'modified independent' student on an appeal basis, despite normally being dependent.

gro-ca.label: Third Party Letter
gro-ca.definition: A letter from a responsible third party testifying as to the truthfulness of the student’s explanation and providing an independent assessment of the situation.

gro-ca.label: Responsible Third Party
gro-ca.definition: A role held by a person such as a counselor, psychologist, religious advisor, doctor, teacher, or mature relative outside the immediate family or family friend, who provides a letter of support.

gro-ca.label: Professional Third Party
gro-ca.definition: A professional third party includes, but is not limited to: counselor, psychologist, religious advisor, doctor, teacher, police, and/or staff at a social service agency such as an organization supporting those experiencing abuse or violence.

gro-ca.label: Allowable Cost
gro-ca.definition: StudentAid BC considers specific allowable costs that will have a direct impact on the student during their study period. Many of the allowable costs include maximums (caps) set in federal and provincial policy.

gro-ca.label: Field Trip and Placement Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding allocated for actual costs of field trips, practicums, and clinical placements that are essential elements of an educational program.

gro-ca.label: Travel Expense Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding allocated for travel expenses incurred by students required to travel to a different location as a mandatory part of their program.

gro-ca.label: Student Living Allowance
gro-ca.definition: Student living allowances are standard allowances established by the Government of Canada to cover the costs of shelter, food, local transportation and miscellaneous expenses and used by StudentAid BC to assess financial need for full-time students.

gro-ca.label: Living Allowance
gro-ca.definition: A financial resource allocated to cover living expenses.

gro-ca.label: Dependant Allowance
gro-ca.definition: A financial allowance provided to students with dependants, as specified in Table 3 of Chapter 14.

gro-ca.label: Dependent Student Role
gro-ca.definition: A role held by dependent students who must leave their home community to attend post-secondary studies

gro-ca.label: Return Transportation Allowance
gro-ca.definition: A return transportation allowance covering one return trip to the student's permanent home

gro-ca.label: Return Transportation Cost Assessment Permission
gro-ca.definition: A permission for eligible students to have their indicated cost of return transportation assessed subject to limits.

gro-ca.label: Eligible Student Role
gro-ca.definition: A role held by a student who is married, common-law, independent single, or single-parent, living away from home for full-time study, and meeting the specified living arrangement criteria.

gro-ca.label: Return Transportation Cost
gro-ca.definition: The cost of return transportation indicated by a student on their application form.

gro-ca.label: Cost Assessment Action
gro-ca.definition: The action of assessing a student's indicated cost of return transportation subject to specified limits.

gro-ca.label: Additional Weekly Allowance
gro-ca.definition: An additional weekly allowance to assist with the costs of maintaining a separate residence for married or common-law students living away from the family home.

gro-ca.label: Married/Common-Law Student Living Away
gro-ca.definition: A married student or common-law student who needs to live away from the usual family home in a different city to pursue their studies.

gro-ca.label: Other Costs and Resource Assessments
gro-ca.definition: Additional costs and resource assessments that may be included or adjusted by StudentAid BC during an appeal.

gro-ca.label: Appeal Process
gro-ca.definition: The condition during which an appeal is underway, triggering discretionary adjustments to student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: Student and Family Resources
gro-ca.definition: To describe the various student and/or family resources that are included in the financial need assessment to determine an expected student, spousal and/or parental contribution(s) to meet the assessed costs of post-secondary study.

gro-ca.label: Federal Fixed Student Contribution
gro-ca.definition: The federal fixed student contribution, a calculated amount based on study weeks and capped at 34 2/3 weeks per loan year.

gro-ca.label: Family Income
gro-ca.definition: family income is defined as the sum of student’s income and spouse’s/common-law partner’s income (as reported on both the student’s and spouse’s/common-law partner’s line 15000 [total income] of their respective previous year’s T1 General Income Tax and Benefit Return), or international equivalent.

gro-ca.label: Dependant
gro-ca.definition: The student’s or spouse/common-law partner’s children are permanently disabled, are 19 years of age or over, are fully supported by the student or spouse/common-law partner and are claimed on the student’s or spouse/common-law partner’s income tax return; or the children are the student’s foster children and foster-parent income is claimed on the application.

gro-ca.label: Scholarship and Bursary Resource
gro-ca.definition: Merit-based scholarships and/or needs-based bursaries that students are expected to contribute from as additional resources.

gro-ca.label: Expected Contribution from Need-Based Bursaries
gro-ca.definition: The expected contribution from need-based bursaries, where the eligibility criteria are based on need, but the funding is not targeted for a specific element of the costs of living or education. The expected contribution is equivalent to the assessed actual amount, less an exemption of $1,800 per program year for both merit-based scholarships and need-based bursaries combined. Any amount of scholarship/bursary funding above $1,800 is considered income and is assessed at 100%.

gro-ca.label: Targeted Resource
gro-ca.definition: Targeted resources are those provided to help with specific educational costs, and may include funds received from municipal, provincial or federal governments, and/or the private sector.

gro-ca.label: Voluntary Contribution
gro-ca.definition: Voluntary contributions include all sources of funding for the specific purpose of helping with the costs of post-secondary study that are provided to a student by their parent(s), step-parent, sponsor, or legal guardian.

gro-ca.label: Spousal Contribution Amount
gro-ca.definition: A calculated amount representing a spouse's expected contribution, determined as 10% of the total family income above the CSFA Program income threshold, pro-rated weekly and applied for each week of the student's study period, capped at 34 2/3 weeks if enrolled in more than 34 2/3 weeks.

gro-ca.label: Expected Contribution
gro-ca.definition: A financial contribution from a student, parent, step-parent, sponsor, legal guardian or spouse to assist with the cost of the student’s program of study. The contribution is automatically assessed during the student need assessment process.

gro-ca.label: Spousal Expected Contribution
gro-ca.definition: A calculated amount representing the expected financial contribution from a spouse, based on spousal income, used in student assessment.

gro-ca.label: Parent Living Outside Canada
gro-ca.definition: A role held by a parent who resides outside Canada for the purposes of student financial assistance income reporting.

gro-ca.label: Appendix 1
gro-ca.definition: A form used to report parental income and assets when parents live outside Canada.

gro-ca.label: Parental Income Reporting Calculation
gro-ca.definition: A calculation rule defining how parents living outside Canada must report their income and assets on Appendix 1, including conditional logic for unfiled Canadian tax returns.

gro-ca.label: Family Size
gro-ca.definition: Family size includes all children 18 years of age and under, all children aged 19 and over who are full-time dependent students, children with disabilities aged 19 and over, elderly relatives who are fully supported by the parent(s) and declared on the T1 General Income Tax and Benefit Return, and foster children where foster parent income is claimed on Appendix 1.

gro-ca.label: Student Award
gro-ca.definition: A financial award composed of loans, grants, and bursaries allocated to a student based on assessed federal and provincial needs.

gro-ca.label: WorkBC Employment Services Funds
gro-ca.definition: Funds provided by the WorkBC Employment Services Program for educational costs, training allowance, or transportation allowance.

gro-ca.label: Disability Assistance Funds
gro-ca.definition: Funds provided for living costs under the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Act.

gro-ca.label: WorkBC ES and DA Student
gro-ca.definition: A student who is receiving WorkBC Employment Services funds for full educational costs and Disability Assistance funds for living costs under the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Act.

gro-ca.label: Income Assistance Recipient
gro-ca.definition: A person who receives income assistance under the B.C. Employment and Assistance Act.

gro-ca.label: Full-Time Post-Secondary Enrollment
gro-ca.definition: The condition of being enrolled in full-time post-secondary studies.

gro-ca.label: Disability Student Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding designed to help people with disabilities and their dependents with basic educational costs, subject to limitations established under inter-ministry policy.

gro-ca.label: Transportation and Miscellaneous Allowance
gro-ca.definition: A fixed weekly allowance of $23 per week of study for transportation and/or miscellaneous education-related costs.

gro-ca.label: Child Care Cost Reimbursement
gro-ca.definition: Reimbursement of actual child care costs incurred, up to a maximum of $268 per child per week, less any subsidy received.

gro-ca.label: Minimum Award Amount
gro-ca.definition: The minimum award amount that can be disbursed, inclusive of Canada Student Loan, B.C. Student Loan and federal and provincial grants and bursaries, is $100 per study period.

gro-ca.label: Student Dependent Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding allocated to students with dependents, providing a maximum of $740 per week of study.

gro-ca.label: Full-time Student
gro-ca.definition: A student enrolled in full-time post-secondary studies.

gro-ca.label: B.C. Access Grant
gro-ca.definition: A grant provided under the British Columbia Access Grant Program.

gro-ca.label: Successful Reinstatement Student
gro-ca.definition: A student who has successfully completed reinstatement or appeal to StudentAid BC.

gro-ca.label: Scholastic Standing Requirement
gro-ca.definition: A student has met the scholastic standing requirement if the post-secondary institution indicates the student has maintained a satisfactory scholastic standard based on the standards and expectations of that institution and/or if a course credit was granted. This is not dependent on the student meeting the post-secondary institution’s grade point average.

gro-ca.label: Withdrawn Student
gro-ca.definition: Students are considered to have withdrawn if they transfer to a new post-secondary institution and there is a gap of more than two weeks between the last date of attendance at the first post-secondary institution and the first date of attendance at the second post-secondary institution.

gro-ca.label: Withdrawal Date
gro-ca.definition: The withdrawal date is dependent on missed deadlines. The withdrawal date is the start of classes if the first assignment or exam deadline was missed or the first assignment deadline date if the second assignment or exam was missed, etc.

gro-ca.label: Non-Punitive Withdrawal Form
gro-ca.definition: A form used to report non-punitive withdrawals from a study period to StudentAid BC.

gro-ca.label: Early Completion of Studies Notification Form
gro-ca.definition: A form used by school officials to notify StudentAid BC of a student's early completion of studies.

gro-ca.label: Student Financial Assistance Application
gro-ca.definition: An application form for student financial assistance programs in Canada.

gro-ca.label: Returning Withdrawn Student Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of a student who originally applied for a two-semester period, withdrew in the first semester, and wishes to re-enter the same post-secondary institution and program for the start of the second semester.

gro-ca.label: Additional Funds
gro-ca.definition: Supplementary financial resources provided for a study period extension.

gro-ca.label: Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills
gro-ca.definition: The Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills, a regulatory authority agent in Canada.

gro-ca.label: Appendix 7
gro-ca.definition: A required documentation form for certain circumstance changes in Canadian student funding programs.

gro-ca.label: Government-Issued Identification
gro-ca.definition: An official document issued by a government authority that confirms a person's identity, including name and date of birth.

gro-ca.label: Social Insurance Number Card
gro-ca.definition: A card or letter issued by the Government of Canada that displays a person's Social Insurance Number.

gro-ca.label: Designated Post-Secondary Institution
gro-ca.definition: A post-secondary educational institution designated under Canadian regulations.

gro-ca.label: Institutional Transfer Form
gro-ca.definition: A form required for students transferring between campuses of the same institution.

gro-ca.label: Overaward
gro-ca.definition: Excess student financial assistance received beyond eligibility, subject to deduction from future loan entitlement.

gro-ca.label: Grant Overaward
gro-ca.definition: A grant overaward resulting from a change in assessed financial need, which may be converted to a loan under specified conditions.

gro-ca.label: National Student Loans Service Centre
gro-ca.definition: The National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC), responsible for administering and disbursing Canada Student Loans and Grants.

gro-ca.label: Late Continuation
