gro-ca.definition: Late continuation occurs when less than six months have elapsed between a full-time borrower’s previously confirmed PSED and subsequent PSCD during their current period of studies, but the Confirmation of Enrolment is received after more than six months have elapsed.

gro-ca.label: Borrower Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of an individual who has received a loan and is subject to repayment and leave provisions under Canadian regulations.

gro-ca.label: Medical or Parental Leave
gro-ca.definition: A leave from Canada-B.C. integrated student loan repayment obligations granted for medical or parental reasons.

gro-ca.label: Medical or Parental Leave Application
gro-ca.definition: The act of applying for medical or parental leave while enrolled in studies.

gro-ca.label: Formal Withdrawal from Studies
gro-ca.definition: The act of formally withdrawing from studies with an educational institution.

gro-ca.label: Leave Extension
gro-ca.definition: The action of extending a medical or parental leave period by a borrower.

gro-ca.label: Leave Period
gro-ca.definition: A period during which a borrower is not required to make payments or attend studies, subject to eligibility rules.

gro-ca.label: Post-Secondary Studies
gro-ca.definition: The action of attending post-secondary educational studies.

gro-ca.label: Canada-B.C. Integrated Student Loan
gro-ca.definition: A financial resource representing a Canada-B.C. integrated student loan disbursed on or after August 1, 2000.

gro-ca.label: RAP Stage 2 Eligible Borrower
gro-ca.definition: A borrower who has been on RAP Stage 1 for at least 60 months or in repayment for at least 10 years, and is eligible for RAP Stage 2.

gro-ca.label: RAP Stage 2
gro-ca.definition: The second stage of the Repayment Assistance Plan, providing coverage of principal and interest not covered by the borrower's affordable monthly payment.

gro-ca.label: Administrative Measures Restriction
gro-ca.definition: A restriction imposed by administrative measures that limits a borrower's activities or status.

gro-ca.label: Repayment Assistance Plan
gro-ca.definition: A program that provides financial relief to eligible borrowers struggling to repay their student loans.

gro-ca.label: Stage 1 Eligibility
gro-ca.definition: The set of criteria that must be met for a borrower to qualify for Stage 1 of the Repayment Assistance Plan.

gro-ca.label: New Application
gro-ca.definition: A formal request submitted by a borrower to continue receiving financial support under the RAP program for a subsequent period.

gro-ca.label: Unverified Borrower Role
gro-ca.definition: A role held by borrowers who have not had their persistent or prolonged disability previously verified with the StudentAid BC or CSFA Program prior to their RAP-D application

gro-ca.label: Disability Proof Resource
gro-ca.definition: Proof of a persistent or prolonged disability, such as the RAP-D Verification of Disability Questionnaire and related documentation

gro-ca.label: RAP Applicant
gro-ca.definition: An individual who applies for the Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) benefit

gro-ca.label: RAP Application
gro-ca.definition: The application form, either online or paper, used to apply for the Repayment Assistance Plan

gro-ca.label: Defaulted Borrower Role
gro-ca.definition: Role of a borrower who had defaulted (not declared bankruptcy) and whose loans have been sent for collections and subsequently extinguished, written off, designated uncollectable by the Limitation Act, or settled.

gro-ca.label: Bankrupt Borrower Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of a person who has been declared bankrupt and is subject to the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act

gro-ca.label: Court
gro-ca.definition: A judicial body with authority to grant bankruptcy discharge under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act

gro-ca.label: Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act
gro-ca.definition: The Canadian federal statute governing bankruptcy and insolvency proceedings

gro-ca.label: Severe Permanent Disability Borrower
gro-ca.definition: A borrower role for individuals with a severe permanent disability, as defined under the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit.

gro-ca.label: Student Loan Debt
gro-ca.definition: A financial obligation arising from a student loan.

gro-ca.label: Severe Permanent Disability Benefit Adjudication
gro-ca.definition: The adjudication process for the Severe Permanent Disability Benefit.

gro-ca.label: RAP Recovery Obligation
gro-ca.definition: The obligation for borrowers to fulfill RAP recovery requirements to remove their affordable payment restriction.

gro-ca.label: Bankruptcy Appeal Process
gro-ca.definition: The process by which a borrower appeals a bankruptcy-related restriction on student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: Student Borrower
gro-ca.definition: A role held by an individual who has received a student loan.

gro-ca.label: Part-Time Student
gro-ca.definition: For part-time, the student must successfully complete all courses for which their Canada Student Financial Assistance Program funding was issued. If the student is studying at 20% of a full-time course load and drops their only course, this is considered a withdrawal.

gro-ca.label: Incarcerated or Warranted Student Role
gro-ca.definition: A role held by a student who is incarcerated or has an outstanding warrant for arrest, as defined in the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act.

gro-ca.label: CSFA Program Funding
gro-ca.definition: Funding issued under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program.

gro-ca.label: Eligible Part-Time Student Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of an eligible part-time student who is attending part-time studies in eligible full-time programs and may receive student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: BCAG Excess Loan
gro-ca.definition: A provincial loan converted from excess BCAG grant received by a student upon reassessment based on new information.

gro-ca.label: Financial Need Assessment
gro-ca.definition: Financial need for part-time studies is determined based on an assessment of allowable educational costs, including tuition, books/supplies, miscellaneous allowance, transportation allowance, and child care costs.

gro-ca.label: Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment
gro-ca.definition: A grant for students with disabilities requiring exceptional education-related services or equipment, up to $20,000 per program year.

gro-ca.label: Student with Disability Role
gro-ca.definition: A role held by a student with a permanent, persistent, or prolonged disability who requires exceptional education-related services or equipment.

gro-ca.label: Part-Time MSFAA
gro-ca.definition: The Part-Time MSFAA is a legal document comprised of two separate loan contracts with the federal and provincial governments.

gro-ca.label: Financial Aid Officer Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of a financial aid officer in the context of Canadian post-secondary education regulations.

gro-ca.label: Post-Secondary Institution Owner/Operator Role
gro-ca.definition: The role of an owner or operator of a post-secondary institution in Canada.

gro-ca.label: Request for Cancellation Letter
gro-ca.definition: A formal letter requesting cancellation, typically submitted by financial aid officers or institution owners/operators.

gro-ca.label: Funding and Loan Rehabilitation Application
gro-ca.definition: An application submitted by a student for funding and loan rehabilitation, subject to review under specified conditions.

gro-ca.label: Provincial Program
gro-ca.definition: A program administered by a provincial government, such as financial assistance or social services.

gro-ca.label: Exceptional Circumstance
gro-ca.definition: A condition representing exceptional circumstances that may be considered for eligibility.

gro-ca.label: Appeal Request Form
gro-ca.definition: The appropriate form used by students to initiate an appeal.

gro-ca.label: Repeat Course
gro-ca.definition: A course that a student has previously attempted or completed, for which approval may be sought to repeat.

gro-ca.label: Course Approval
gro-ca.definition: An official authorization or permission granted for a specific course-related action.

gro-ca.label: Appeal Committee
gro-ca.definition: A body that provides students with a fair and unbiased opportunity to have their appeal decision reconsidered.

gro-ca.label: Review by Appeal Committee
gro-ca.definition: The process by which the Appeal Committee re-evaluates a student's appeal decision.

gro-ca.label: Appeal Denied and Eligible
gro-ca.definition: The condition where a student's appeal is denied and the appealed issue was included in the list of policy and criteria eligible for appeal.

gro-ca.label: Books and Supplies Funding
gro-ca.definition: Maximum funding allocated for books and supplies based on the number of weeks in the study period.

gro-ca.label: Moderate Standard of Living Allowance
gro-ca.definition: The parent’s Moderate Standard of Living allowance does not include security costs for items such as life and employment insurance payments, retirement and pension fund payments, and RRSP payments, and education tuition fees.

gro-ca.label: Academic Year
gro-ca.definition: For the purpose of assessment of need, the academic year is defined by the post-secondary institution and is based on the study period for which student financial assistance is required that starts between August 1 of the current year and July 31 of the following year. The academic year is subject to a maximum length of 12 months (52 weeks) and may include multiple terms or semesters, including spring and/or summer sessions.

gro-ca.label: Accessible Education and Training Courses
gro-ca.definition: Accessible Education and Training (AET) Courses at the adult basic education level that are designed for individuals with permanent disabilities or combinations of learning difficulties.

gro-ca.label: Appeal (Student)
gro-ca.definition: An appeal is a formal request for a review of a student’s application assessment to take into account exceptional circumstances demonstrated or proven by the applicant, which may result in StudentAid BC setting aside standard program policy.

gro-ca.label: Resources
gro-ca.definition: Resources do not include child tax benefits, T1 General Income Tax and Benefit Return refunds, family bonuses or GST rebates.

gro-ca.label: Default
gro-ca.definition: In relation to a student loan, of which the Borrower is more than 270 days in arrears on payments based on the Borrower's loan agreement and in respect of which collection action is taken.

gro-ca.label: Dependents
gro-ca.definition: The dependents are the student’s or spouse/common-law partner’s elderly relatives who are fully supported by the student and claimed on the student’s or spouse’s income tax.

gro-ca.label: Repayment Obligation
gro-ca.definition: The set of repayment duties owed by a borrower under a student loan.

gro-ca.label: Discretionary Income
gro-ca.definition: Discretionary Income is total income for the full taxation year before the student’s study period, less the costs for taxes, CPP/QPP and EI from Appendix 1 and less the estimated costs for a Moderate Standard of Living from Table 5.

gro-ca.label: Field Placement
gro-ca.definition: A field placement provides students with an intensive part-time/short term intensive hands-on practical experience in a setting relevant to their subject of study. Field placements may not require supervision of a registered or licensed professional and the completed work experience hours are not required for professional certification. Field placements account for work-integrated educational experiences not encompassed by other forms, such as co-op, clinic, practicum, and internship.

gro-ca.label: Funded Term/Period of Study
gro-ca.definition: A period of study during which a student receives student financial assistance and/or payment-free status. Students who are on payment-free status are considered to be in a ‘funded term’ whether or not they have new student loans; withdrawals and unsuccessful terms are counted during this time.

gro-ca.label: Guardian
gro-ca.definition: A person who is charged with the legal right and duty of care for a ward due to the ward’s inability (due to age, or mental or physical inability) to care for himself or herself.

gro-ca.label: Institution Location
gro-ca.definition: Any location of a post-secondary institution other than the main campus, but under the same corporate structure as the main campus

gro-ca.label: Campus
gro-ca.definition: A campus has a separate student body, a resident administration, offers a full program leading to a certificate, diploma or degree, and is geographically separate from the main campus such that students may not easily avail themselves of educational and administrative services at the main campus.

gro-ca.label: Instructional Hours
gro-ca.definition: The time spent in a classroom or other learning environment where both student and instructor are present.

gro-ca.label: Legal Guardian
gro-ca.definition: A legal guardian is a person who has the legal authority, and duty, to care for another person.

gro-ca.label: Loan Year
gro-ca.definition: Loan Year means the period beginning August 1, in any year, and ending on July 31, the following year.

gro-ca.label: Mutually Exclusive Courses
gro-ca.definition: Courses that have a different course name and number but have the same content as another course. Students who are taking duplicate or mutually exclusive courses will not be granted credit for a second time and the duplicate course will not be counted when determining a student’s course load of study for StudentAid BC purposes.

gro-ca.label: Non-punitive Withdrawal
gro-ca.definition: Non-punitive Withdrawal (withdrawal before classes start) is allowed if the student has repaid the total amount funded within 30 days of deposit of funds. If an application cannot be cancelled for the initial disbursement of the application due to issuance of funding through electronic funds transfer, a non-punitive withdrawal will be allowed if the student has repaid the total amount funded within 30 days of deposit of funds. Non-punitive Withdrawal (due to institution closure) If students are withdrawn due to institution closure as outlined in Chapter 9, Section 4, the withdrawal can be considered non-punitive.

gro-ca.label: Parental Living Allowance
gro-ca.definition: A moderate standard of living allowance set by the Government of Canada that is a measure of the cost of living that includes shelter, food, miscellaneous expenses and transportation, and takes into account family size. This amount is used in calculating the contribution parents are expected to make towards a dependant student’s education expenses.

gro-ca.label: Persistent or Prolonged Disability
gro-ca.definition: Any impairment, including a physical, mental, intellectual, cognitive, learning, communication or sensory impairment - or a functional limitation - that restricts the ability of a person to perform the daily activities necessary to pursue studies at a post-secondary school level or to participate in the labour force and has lasted, or is expected to last, for a period of at least 12 months but is not expected to remain with the person for the person's expected life.

gro-ca.label: Protected Person
gro-ca.definition: Protected Persons include Convention Refugees and Humanitarian-Protected Persons Abroad classes, and persons in need of protection, defined as a person whose removal to their country of nationality or former habitual residence would subject them to the possibility of torture, risk of life, or risk of cruel and unusual treatment or punishment.

gro-ca.label: Registered Disability Savings Plan
gro-ca.definition: Registered Disability Savings Plan (RDSP) is a long-term savings plan to help Canadians with disabilities and their families save for the future. Funds held in an RDSP account are exempt as an asset for the purpose of StudentAid BC.

gro-ca.label: Risk-Sharing Loan
gro-ca.definition: Risk-Sharing Loans are loans issued by a financial institution between August 1, 1995 and July 31, 2000 where the Province of British Columbia pays a risk premium to the lending institution based on the value of all loans entering repayment status.

gro-ca.label: Study Period
gro-ca.definition: The study period is the time between the start date and end date specified in the application for student financial assistance.

gro-ca.label: Successful Completion
gro-ca.definition: Identifies a student who has fully completed a study period/semester/term and has also written and passed course exams for the same study period/semester/term.

gro-ca.label: Unmet Need
gro-ca.definition: The amount by which a student’s assessed financial need (Government of Canada or Province of British Columbia) exceeds the total award.

gro-ca.label: Wholly Dependent Person
gro-ca.definition: Wholly dependent persons may include: a child or a grandchild of the student or of the student’s spouse; or the parent, step-parent, grandparent, brother, sister, uncle, aunt, niece or nephew of the student or the student’s spouse, if resident in Canada.

gro-ca.label: Funding Authority
gro-ca.definition: An organisation responsible for administering and disbursing student disability funding.

gro-ca.label: RAP-D Processing
gro-ca.definition: The action of processing a RAP application under the RAP-D stream for borrowers with disabilities.

gro-ca.label: Disability Re-verification
gro-ca.definition: The action of re-verifying a borrower's disability status to maintain eligibility for RAP-D.

gro-uk.label: EPA Rules and Guidance
gro-uk.definition: Existing rules and guidance for end-point assessment (EPA) style plans that remain in effect during the transitional phase.

gro-uk.label: Provider and Employer Role
gro-uk.definition: The combined role of providers and employers who must refer to Annex C for apprenticeship standards.

gro-uk.label: Annex C: Off-the-job Training
gro-uk.definition: Annex C: Off-the-job training: minimum requirement for each apprenticeship standard, a regulatory document on GOV.UK.

gro-uk.label: Main providers and employer-providers
gro-uk.definition: Mentoring must meet the definition of off-the-job training (new learning, relevant to the apprenticeship, not English and maths, delivered within normal working hours) and be documented in the training plan. The mentor must be a more senior or experienced member of staff. This does not include general line management. The apprentice must not be doing productive work.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: Accelerated Note added / amended definitions of the following terms: apprenticeship, Active learning, Adult Skills Fund, Apprenticeship service record, Apprenticeship Technical Funding Guide, Care leavers’ bursary, Complete early, Employer incentive payments, End-point assessment, Final day, Foundation apprenticeship, Gateway requirements, (The) Institute, New provider status (APAR), Off-the-job training, On-programme End-point Assessment, Person of significant control, Prior learning, Prison leaver, Published typical duration, Summary of training document, Total negotiated price (TNP).

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Employer Agreement
gro-uk.definition: The apprenticeship employer agreement between employers and the Secretary of State for Education, which includes the rules governing access to funding through the apprenticeship service.

gro-uk.label: Secretary of State for Education
gro-uk.definition: The role of the Secretary of State for Education as the regulatory authority responsible for the apprenticeship employer agreement.

gro-uk.label: Main Provider
gro-uk.definition: We use the term ‘main provider’ where the funding rule only applies to an organisation that is listed on the main provider route of the Apprenticeship Provider and Assessment Register (APAR).

gro-uk.label: Supplemental Funding Rules and Guidance
gro-uk.definition: Supplemental funding rules and guidance for the two-year growth pilot.

gro-uk.label: Two-Year Growth Pilot
gro-uk.definition: A two-year growth pilot programme involving additional payments.

gro-uk.label: Additional Payment
gro-uk.definition: A funding payment that is due to be paid to an apprentice, but may be delayed under certain conditions.

gro-uk.label: Employer-Provider
gro-uk.definition: We use the term ‘employer-provider’ where the funding rule only applies to a levy-paying organisation that is listed on the employer-provider route of the APAR. Employer-providers can only deliver apprenticeship training to their own staff or those of a connected company or charity and must do so on an actual cost basis (see paragraph 102).

gro-uk.label: Main Provider Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of the main provider responsible for ensuring apprentice preparation and understanding of the apprenticeship assessment process, in consultation with the employer.

gro-uk.label: Subcontractor
gro-uk.definition: An organisation or an individual (not an employee) that is contracted by a provider for the delivery of training and on-programme assessment, as part of the employer’s agreed apprenticeship programme.

gro-uk.label: Employer
gro-uk.definition: This can include a Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agency (FJAA). This may also include a company or charity whose PAYE scheme the employer has connected to their apprenticeship service account. References to an ‘employer’ describe the whole organisation, not individual sites, locations, groups, or companies linked by directors.

gro-uk.label: Connected Company or Charity
gro-uk.definition: Companies or charities whose PAYE scheme the employer has connected to their apprenticeship service account in accordance with HMRC's definition of connected companies and charities.

gro-uk.label: Learner
gro-uk.definition: A role held by an individual who is receiving education or training.

gro-uk.label: Programme
gro-uk.definition: A structured course of study or training for which funding eligibility must be assessed.

gro-uk.label: Initial Assessment
gro-uk.definition: An evaluation process conducted to determine the eligibility of a learner and a programme for funding.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Funding
gro-uk.definition: Funding for an apprenticeship, determined by the availability of levy funds in an employer's apprenticeship service account each month.

gro-uk.label: Care Leavers' Bursary
gro-uk.definition: Care leavers’ bursary is an additional £3,000 payment (paid in 3 instalments) that we pay to apprentices who are in care or are care leavers, and who started their apprenticeship training on or after 1

gro-uk.label: Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: A person who is learning a trade from a skilled employer, having agreed to work for a fixed period at low wages.

gro-uk.label: Employer
gro-uk.definition: The employer responsible for the apprenticeship, who must pay the difference when the overall price exceeds the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Level 7 Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: A Level 7 apprenticeship program as defined by UK government funding rules.

gro-uk.label: Government Funding Action
gro-uk.definition: The action of providing government funding for an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Funding Resource
gro-uk.definition: Financial resources allocated to support training or education, such as apprenticeship funding.

gro-uk.label: Employment Status Condition
gro-uk.definition: A condition concerning the employment status of an individual, such as being employed or unemployed.

gro-uk.label: Eligibility
gro-uk.definition: An individual's eligibility status for an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Student Loan
gro-uk.definition: A loan provided to students to fund their education, which is prohibited from being used to pay for an apprenticeship under certain conditions.

gro-uk.label: Working Hours
gro-uk.definition: The hours worked by an apprentice, which must be considered when setting the duration of off-the-job training.

gro-uk.label: DfE Funded Course
gro-uk.definition: An existing course funded by the Department for Education.

gro-uk.label: Financial Resource
gro-uk.definition: A resource representing monetary value or financial instruments, such as profit, fees, or funds.

gro-uk.label: Evidence of Eligibility
gro-uk.definition: Documentation or records that demonstrate an individual meets the eligibility criteria for funding.

gro-uk.label: Evidence
gro-uk.definition: Evidence that the provider is directly delivering apprenticeship training and/or on-programme assessment and maintaining the employer relationship.

gro-uk.label: Employment Evidence
gro-uk.definition: Evidence to confirm that the apprentice is employed by that employer, or a connected company or charity and this employment covers the full period of the apprenticeship, including the end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Prior Learning and Experience
gro-uk.definition: An individual's previously attained knowledge, skills, and behaviours relevant to an apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Rules Paragraphs
gro-uk.definition: A set of regulatory rules referenced by paragraph numbers, such as paragraphs 33.2 to 33.4.

gro-uk.label: Progression Profile
gro-uk.definition: A published document that identifies whether a subsequent apprenticeship in the same occupational area can be funded, and if so, whether that apprenticeship must be an accelerated apprenticeship with an adjustment in content and price.

gro-uk.label: T-Level
gro-uk.definition: A technical qualification completed by an individual, serving as a condition for considering progression profiles.

gro-uk.label: Repeated Training
gro-uk.definition: Training that needs to be repeated to meet the accreditation requirements of a regulated profession.

gro-uk.label: Industry Professional Body
gro-uk.definition: A relevant industry or professional body that can provide further advice on accreditation requirements.

gro-uk.label: Prior Learning Percentage
gro-uk.definition: The percentage of prior learning that an individual has, calculated as a percentage of the off-the-job training hours that would be delivered to an individual with no relevant prior learning for the same standard.

gro-uk.label: Total Price
gro-uk.definition: The total price for an apprenticeship, subject to reduction based on prior learning percentage and funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Funding Band Maximum
gro-uk.definition: The maximum funding band for an apprenticeship, used as a reference for the assessment cost cap.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Price Reduction
gro-uk.definition: A calculated entity representing the mandatory reduction in the total price of apprenticeship funding when an apprentice has 30% prior learning, requiring at least a 15% reduction from the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Maximum Funding Amount
gro-uk.definition: A resource representing the maximum funding amount allocated for a specific purpose, such as apprenticeship funding.

gro-uk.label: Summary of Impact
gro-uk.definition: A summary of the impact of prior learning and experience on apprenticeship content and price, including whether and by how much content and price have been reduced, and confirmation that the resulting apprenticeship meets funding rules regarding minimum duration and off-the-job training.

gro-uk.label: Learning Support Funding
gro-uk.definition: Funding available to meet the costs incurred by a provider of putting in place reasonable adjustments for an apprentice, as set out in section 20 of the Equality Act 2010.

gro-uk.label: Apprentices Needing Learning Support
gro-uk.definition: Has a learning difficulty or disability as defined in Section 15ZA(6) of the Education Act 1996 (as amended by section 41 of the Apprenticeships, Skills, Children and Learning Act 2009), who, as a result of this learning difficulty or disability, requires reasonable adjustments in order to be able to complete their apprenticeship, including any reasonable adjustments to complete English and / or maths requirements (this includes where apprentices have opted-in – see paragraph 46) and end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Learning Difficulty or Disability
gro-uk.definition: For the purposes of this section, and as defined in Section 15ZA(6) of the Education Act 1996, a person has a learning difficulty (or disability) if (a) the person has a significantly greater difficulty in learning than the majority of persons of the same age, or (b) the person has a disability which either prevents or hinders the person from making use of facilities of a kind generally provided by institutions providing education or training for persons who are over compulsory school age.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice with Newly Identified LDD
gro-uk.definition: this can include an apprentice who has not previously had a learning difficulty or disability identified, but in relation to whom the provider has identified a learning difficulty or disability (as defined in Section 15ZA(6) of the Education Act 1996) that would directly affect the apprentice’s ability to complete their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Learning Support Claim
gro-uk.definition: A claim for learning support made during an apprenticeship

gro-uk.label: Learning Support
gro-uk.definition: Financial support that providers can claim to help with the cost of any reasonable adjustments directly related to an apprenticeship, currently a fixed monthly amount of £150.

gro-uk.label: Evidence Requirement
gro-uk.definition: A set of requirements that must be met to provide evidence for a claim.

gro-uk.label: Reasonable Adjustment Funding
gro-uk.definition: Funding allocated to a provider for reasonable adjustments that are necessary, delivered, evidenced, and reported in the ILR.

gro-uk.label: EAS Additional Costs
gro-uk.definition: Additional costs claimable via the earnings adjustment statement (EAS) when the cost exceeds £150 per month but is less than £19,000 per annum.

gro-uk.label: Review
gro-uk.definition: A formal assessment or examination of something with the possibility or intention of instituting change if necessary.

gro-uk.label: Progress Review Discussion
gro-uk.definition: A discussion held as part of a progress review, typically involving the apprentice and employer.

gro-uk.label: Learning Support Requirement
gro-uk.definition: A requirement for additional support in learning, which an apprentice may disclose to their employer.

gro-uk.label: ILR and EAS Claim Action
gro-uk.definition: The act of submitting a claim for learning support funding through the Individualised Learner Record (ILR) and the Earnings Adjustment Statement (EAS) systems.

gro-uk.label: Last ILR Collection Deadline
gro-uk.definition: The temporal condition that the deadline for claiming is the last ILR collection for each funding year.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Requiring Substantial Adjustments
gro-uk.definition: An apprentice who requires substantial reasonable adjustments to start or continue learning.

gro-uk.label: ELS Claim Form
gro-uk.definition: The exceptional learning support cost form that can be accessed on GOV.UK.

gro-uk.label: Document
gro-uk.definition: A written or recorded piece of information that serves as evidence or a record.

gro-uk.label: Reasonable Adjustment Plan
gro-uk.definition: A documented plan outlining how necessary reasonable adjustments will be delivered throughout an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Application and Supporting Evidence
gro-uk.definition: Documentation comprising the application and supporting evidence for an exceptional learning support claim.

gro-uk.label: Active Learning
gro-uk.definition: Learning activities carried out by an apprentice in line with a signed training plan, distinct from off-the-job training active learning.

gro-uk.label: Signed Training Plan
gro-uk.definition: A formal document outlining the training and assessment plan for an apprentice, signed by relevant parties.

gro-uk.label: English and Maths Funding
gro-uk.definition: A condition where funding for English and/or maths study is being accessed for an apprentice.

gro-uk.label: Approved Level 2 Qualification
gro-uk.definition: An approved level 2 qualification in both English and maths subjects

gro-uk.label: Funding Body
gro-uk.definition: The government body that provides apprenticeship funding, referred to as 'us' in the provision.

gro-uk.label: Training Plan
gro-uk.definition: For standards with a mandatory qualification this must be, as a minimum, a list of the units, along with a description of any additional activities that the apprentice will undertake to develop occupational competency.

gro-uk.label: Training
gro-uk.definition: A resource representing the necessary amount of training needed in readiness for assessments.

gro-uk.label: Standalone Qualification
gro-uk.definition: A standalone English and/or maths qualification that may be studied as part of an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Assessment
gro-uk.definition: An evaluation or test taken by an apprentice as part of their apprenticeship program

gro-uk.label: Standalone Qualification Funding Condition
gro-uk.definition: A condition where a standalone English and/or maths qualification is being funded as part of the programme, and the apprentice lacks acceptable evidence of previous attainment.

gro-uk.label: Starting Level
gro-uk.definition: The level an apprentice must start working towards as determined by the assessment outcome.

gro-uk.label: English and Maths Requirement
gro-uk.definition: The requirement to achieve the minimum required level in English and maths, which is not removed by the assessment outcome determination.

gro-uk.label: English and Maths Training
gro-uk.definition: Training in English and/or maths delivered as part of an apprenticeship training plan.

gro-uk.label: Appropriate Professional
gro-uk.definition: A professional with suitable knowledge and expertise to assess learning difficulties or disabilities

gro-uk.label: Education Health and Care Plan
gro-uk.definition: An education, health and care plan issued for an individual

gro-uk.label: Legacy Equivalent Plan
gro-uk.definition: A statement of special educational need or a learning difficulty assessment

gro-uk.label: Formal Assessment
gro-uk.definition: A thorough and evidence-based assessment of learning difficulty or disability completed in a formal and structured manner

gro-uk.label: Literacy and Numeracy Development
gro-uk.definition: Further literacy and numeracy development, including level 1 and level 2 courses, provided as part of overall training provision.

gro-uk.label: Judgement
gro-uk.definition: A formal and structured judgement as referenced in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Appropriate Professional Role
gro-uk.definition: A role held by an appropriate professional associated with the provider or subcontractor, such as the head of SEN or student support, or an equivalent individual with suitable knowledge and expertise.

gro-uk.label: Flexibility
gro-uk.definition: An accommodation or adjustment applied to regulatory requirements for eligible apprentices.

gro-uk.label: SEN Professional
gro-uk.definition: A professional specialising in Special Educational Needs.

gro-uk.label: Review Facility
gro-uk.definition: A facility enabling an apprentice to request a second opinion on a judgement outcome.

gro-uk.label: Evidence of Delivery
gro-uk.definition: Evidence that English and maths delivery has taken place against the training plan.

gro-uk.label: Active Learning Requirement
gro-uk.definition: The requirement that delivery of English and maths must be in line with the active learning requirement.

gro-uk.label: Written Evidence
gro-uk.definition: Documentary evidence of apprentice assessment undertaking and qualification achievement.

gro-uk.label: 16-18 Year-Old Learner
gro-uk.definition: A condition that applies when the apprentice is aged between 16 and 18 years old.

gro-uk.label: English and Maths Resource
gro-uk.definition: The educational resource encompassing English and/or maths subjects.

gro-uk.label: Eligibility Declaration Opportunity
gro-uk.definition: The opportunity for a learner to declare their eligibility for the care leavers' bursary.

gro-uk.label: Initial Assessment Outcome
gro-uk.definition: The documented results of an initial assessment, including evidence of an individual's need for new knowledge, skills, and behaviours, and confirmation that the training meets funding rules.

gro-uk.label: Evidence Action
gro-uk.definition: The act of providing or demonstrating evidence that certain conditions or requirements are met.

gro-uk.label: Discuss or Share Action
gro-uk.definition: The act of discussing or sharing information with relevant parties to ensure mutual understanding.

gro-uk.label: Listed Points
gro-uk.definition: The specific points listed in paragraphs 60 to 62 of the relevant regulatory instrument.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Price
gro-uk.definition: The price agreed or costs claimed for an apprenticeship, including negotiated assessment costs.

gro-uk.label: Contract
gro-uk.definition: A signed and dated contract for services between a provider and an employer, including details of price reduction, negotiation, employer contribution, and co-investment.

gro-uk.label: Alternative English Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: An apprenticeship programme in England that provides an alternative funding route for individuals not directly employed by an employer.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Duration
gro-uk.definition: The total time period of an apprenticeship, used as a resource for calculating the 50% threshold.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Agreement
gro-uk.definition: This is defined in section A1(3) of the Apprenticeships, Skills, Children and Learning Act 2009 (as amended by the Enterprise Act 2016) and the Apprenticeships (Miscellaneous Provisions) Regulations 2017.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Programme
gro-uk.definition: A structured training programme for apprentices.

gro-uk.label: Legislative Requirements
gro-uk.definition: The requirements of the legislation that must be met when forming an apprenticeship agreement using an alternative template.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Agreement Formation
gro-uk.definition: The act of forming an apprenticeship agreement.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Agreement Copy
gro-uk.definition: A copy of the completed apprenticeship agreement document.

gro-uk.label: Corporate Entity
gro-uk.definition: A limited company, public services company, partnership, or limited liability partnership created to act as a separate legal entity.

gro-uk.label: Practical Period
gro-uk.definition: The start and end date of the practical period (this is the part of the apprenticeship where evidenced learning is delivered; this does not include the end-point assessment)

gro-uk.label: Practical Period End Date
gro-uk.definition: The practical period end date aligns with the planned learning end date in the ILR.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Start Date
gro-uk.definition: The date shown on the apprenticeship agreement marking the start of the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Provider or Employer
gro-uk.definition: An organisation that is either a training provider or an employer, as referenced in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Alternative English Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: An apprentice participating in an alternative English apprenticeship program, as referenced in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Other Rules Document
gro-uk.definition: The document containing all other rules that must be complied with, as referenced in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Lawful Wage
gro-uk.definition: A wage that complies with national minimum wage regulations.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Rate Resource
gro-uk.definition: The apprentice rate of the national minimum wage as a financial resource.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Wage Rate
gro-uk.definition: The apprentice rate of the national minimum wage as specified in UK regulations.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Period
gro-uk.definition: The period during which an apprentice is actively on an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Practical Period
gro-uk.definition: A period of practical training required for an apprenticeship, with a minimum duration of 8 months after recognition of prior learning.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Return Eligibility Condition
gro-uk.definition: Condition specifying eligibility criteria for returning to the same apprenticeship after a break in learning or withdrawal, including part-time employment hours (<30 hours per week) and zero-hours employment contracts.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Working Hours Condition
gro-uk.definition: A condition where the apprentice works fewer than 30 hours a week or has a zero-hours contract at the beginning of the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice with No Prior Learning
gro-uk.definition: An apprentice who has no relevant prior learning for the standard.

gro-uk.label: Government Funding
gro-uk.definition: A condition where payment is made by government funding, including the apprenticeship levy.

gro-uk.label: Published Minimum Required Hours
gro-uk.definition: The published minimum required hours of training or education that must be delivered.

gro-uk.label: Learning End Date
gro-uk.definition: The date when the last piece of learning has been delivered.

gro-uk.label: Employer Statement
gro-uk.definition: A statement completed by the employer when actual training hours are less than the planned hours.

gro-uk.label: Planned Hours
gro-uk.definition: The scheduled training hours agreed between the provider and the employer.

gro-uk.label: OTJT Minimum Requirement
gro-uk.definition: The published minimum off-the-job training hours required for the apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Off-the-Job Training
gro-uk.definition: Off-the-job training (OTJT) is defined as training which a) is delivering new knowledge, skills and behaviours, b) is directly relevant to the apprenticeship, c) is delivered in the apprentice’s normal working hours (but outside of their productive job role) and d) excludes ineligible activities such as standalone English and maths qualifications. The volume delivered must be based on the published minimum requirement for the standard, adjusted to account for evidenced prior learning that has been identified in the initial assessment of the apprentice.

gro-uk.label: Off-the-Job Training Arrangement
gro-uk.definition: An arrangement for off-the-job training that, by exception, takes place outside of normal hours.

gro-uk.label: Minimum Off-the-Job Training Volume
gro-uk.definition: The minimum volume of off-the-job training for all apprentices (full-time, part-time, term-time), as published on the front of each apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Off-the-Job Training Hours
gro-uk.definition: The calculated entity representing the planned and delivered off-the-job training hours for an apprenticeship programme, including adjustments for prior learning.

gro-uk.label: Off-the-Job Training Parameters
gro-uk.definition: The volume of off-the-job training hours, timeframe, and delivery model to be agreed upon.

gro-uk.label: Training Activity
gro-uk.definition: An off-the-job training activity that is planned and eligible.

gro-uk.label: Individualised Learner Record
gro-uk.definition: A data record containing learner-specific information, including the selected assessment organisation.

gro-uk.label: Typical Planned Hours
gro-uk.definition: The typical planned hours for a standard, as used by providers, which must be at least equal to the off-the-job training minimum requirement published on the standard or in Annex C.

gro-uk.label: OTJT Active Learning Plan
gro-uk.definition: A plan for off-the-job training active learning to take place at least every 3 calendar months of the practical period.

gro-uk.label: Break in Learning
gro-uk.definition: A period during which an apprentice's learning is formally paused, typically used when no off-the-job training active learning is planned within a calendar month.

gro-uk.label: Term-Time Only Contract
gro-uk.definition: An employment contract for apprentices who work only during school term times, excluding holiday periods such as the summer break.

gro-uk.label: OTJT Active Learning
gro-uk.definition: OTJT active learning does not need to be delivered by the provider; it can include any activity that has been agreed and documented as part of the agreed training plan. When the training documented on the training plan is complete, the practical period is complete.

gro-uk.label: Regulatory Body
gro-uk.definition: An organisation responsible for approving providers to deliver apprenticeship training

gro-uk.label: Approval
gro-uk.definition: The official approval granted by a regulatory body to a provider

gro-uk.label: Statement
gro-uk.definition: A formal statement to be signed by the employer and apprentice confirming satisfaction with training delivered.

gro-uk.label: Practical Period End
gro-uk.definition: The temporal condition marking the end of the practical training period.

gro-uk.label: Training Volume Shortfall
gro-uk.definition: A condition where actual off-the-job training volume is less than the planned and agreed volume.

gro-uk.label: Signed Statement
gro-uk.definition: A document that has been completed and signed, required as part of an evidence pack.

gro-uk.label: Evidence Pack
gro-uk.definition: A collection of documents and materials assembled to demonstrate compliance or completion.

gro-uk.label: Broad Agreement
gro-uk.definition: An initial agreement of broad content, such as an email from the employer, evidencing consent to a training plan.

gro-uk.label: Qualifying Day Period
gro-uk.definition: The 42-day qualifying day period by which the signed training plan must be in place.

gro-uk.label: Learning Activity
gro-uk.definition: An educational or training activity related to an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: End-Point Assessment Organisation
gro-uk.definition: End-Point Assessment Organisation responsible for conducting end-point assessment and certification of apprentices

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Details
gro-uk.definition: Details of the apprenticeship include the name of the apprenticeship standard, the level, the start and end dates for both the apprenticeship and the practical period of training.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Provider and Assessment Register
gro-uk.definition: The Apprenticeship Provider and Assessment Register (APAR) as referenced in UK apprenticeship funding regulations.

gro-uk.label: Evidence of Agreement
gro-uk.definition: Evidence that the training plan was agreed by all parties prior to training delivery, including a signed plan by the end of the 42-day qualifying period if agreed virtually.

gro-uk.label: Alternative Frequency
gro-uk.definition: A review frequency that differs from the standard schedule, justified by an evidenced delivery reason.

gro-uk.label: Evidenced Delivery Reason
gro-uk.definition: A condition where a documented reason, such as module length, justifies an alternative review frequency.

gro-uk.label: Learning Support Review
gro-uk.definition: A periodic review of learning support arrangements, required at least every 3 calendar months.

gro-uk.label: Discussion Summary
gro-uk.definition: A document summarizing the discussion between parties in an apprenticeship context.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Service Account
gro-uk.definition: The area on the apprenticeship service where employers can manage their funding and apprentices, view their account balance and plan their spending.

gro-uk.label: Government Co-Investment
gro-uk.definition: A funding allocation representing the government's co-investment contribution for apprenticeships, up to the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Enrolment Administration
gro-uk.definition: Administration related to the subsequent enrolment (onboarding) of the apprentice. This can include the collection of evidence to support the initial assessment, supporting the employer with their apprenticeship service account and completing the apprenticeship agreement; and developing and agreeing the training plan with the employer and apprentice.

gro-uk.label: Relevant Tutor Costs
gro-uk.definition: Relevant tutor costs include salary, on-costs, travel and subsistence claims. On-costs mean employer pension contributions and national insurance. Travel and subsistence costs must relate to apprenticeship delivery.

gro-uk.label: Learning Materials
gro-uk.definition: Learning materials used in the delivery of the apprenticeship (e.g. printed, audio / visual and electronic / interactive materials), including any relevant software licences to access these materials where the licence cost is at apprentice level. Learning materials can be developed in-house or bought from a third party and can be refreshed periodically (e.g. to respond to revisions in the standard, learner and employer feedback).

gro-uk.label: Mandatory Qualification Training Funding
gro-uk.definition: Funding allocated for all training content and peripheral costs (registration, on-programme assessment, examination, certification) associated with a mandatory qualification, provided the qualifications comply with the mandatory qualifications policy.

gro-uk.label: Employer Mentoring Cost
gro-uk.definition: Costs of an employer supporting or mentoring an apprentice, where this is required by the standard and part of the agreed training plan.

gro-uk.label: Additional Learning for Resit Exam
gro-uk.definition: Additional learning required to re-sit an exam linked to either a mandatory qualification or an end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Skills Competition Cost
gro-uk.definition: Costs incurred by an apprentice taking part in any skills competition.

gro-uk.label: Employer-Provider Agreement
gro-uk.definition: An agreement between the employer and provider that participation in a skills competition directly contributes to helping the apprentice achieve the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Peripheral Costs
gro-uk.definition: Peripheral costs associated with a mandatory qualification. These include registration, formative on-programme assessment costs, examination and certification costs, plus the cost of one re-sit (per mandatory qualification) where needed.

gro-uk.label: Staff Salary and On-Costs
gro-uk.definition: Proportionate salary and on-costs of staff who are directly involved in the programme governance, management and administration of the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Software System Costs
gro-uk.definition: The costs of using an apprenticeship software system to return management information (e.g. salary and on-costs of management information staff and the software licences to operate the MI system).

gro-uk.label: External Placement Hosting Fee
gro-uk.definition: Costs of hosting an external placement for the nursing associate apprenticeship, separate from delivery costs of training and on-programme assessment.

gro-uk.label: Original Teaching Material Development
gro-uk.definition: Development of original teaching materials related to a new apprenticeship offer means the first time a provider chooses to deliver a new apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Provider / Subcontractor Induction Activities
gro-uk.definition: Provider / subcontractor induction activities may include outlining behaviour expectations and issuing the apprentice with any workbooks, contact details, logins and passwords.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Wages and Benefits
gro-uk.definition: Apprentice wages / benefits (including wages / costs of backfill arrangements).

gro-uk.label: Student Membership Fee
gro-uk.definition: Student membership fees that are required by professional bodies, even where linked to a mandatory qualification.

gro-uk.label: Excess Training
gro-uk.definition: Any training (e.g. optional modules, educational trips, industry visits, expert speakers or trips to professional events), in excess of that required to pass the end-point assessment and achieve the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Examinations and Other Testing
gro-uk.definition: Examinations and other testing, such as on-programme assessments (linked to a qualification) and mock testing (relating to the end-point assessment) are ineligible costs.

gro-uk.label: Financial Inducement
gro-uk.definition: Financial inducements, or any other payment not authorised by the regulatory authority, in relation to any part of an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Ineligible Cost
gro-uk.definition: A cost that is explicitly excluded from being claimed or included under a regulatory scheme.

gro-uk.label: Final Additional Payment
gro-uk.definition: A final additional payment for apprenticeship standards with a published typical duration of less than 12 months, and for foundation apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Employer and Provider Payments
gro-uk.definition: Payments made to an employer-provider in both the employer and provider capacities.

gro-uk.label: Bursary Resource
gro-uk.definition: A financial bursary resource allocated to eligible apprentices.

gro-uk.label: Co-investment Waiver
gro-uk.definition: A waiver of the co-investment contribution required from an employer for apprenticeship funding.

gro-uk.label: Individualised Learner Record
gro-uk.definition: The Individualised Learner Record (ILR) is a data collection system used by UK education providers to report learner data.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Remaining Payment
gro-uk.definition: A funding resource representing the remaining 50% of an apprenticeship payment, allocated 365 days after the apprentice's learning start date, conditional on the apprentice still undertaking their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Payment
gro-uk.definition: A payment generated for an apprentice under specific apprenticeship conditions, such as shorter or foundation apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Eligible Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: A role held by an apprentice who meets the eligibility criteria for the care leavers' bursary.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Bursary
gro-uk.definition: A bursary of £3,000 available to eligible apprentices across apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agency
gro-uk.definition: An agency that employs apprentices and places them with host employers under a flexi-job apprenticeship arrangement.

gro-uk.label: Employer Additional Payment
gro-uk.definition: An additional payment made to an employer, specifically applicable when an apprentice is employed by a Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agency.

gro-uk.label: Care Leaver Bursary
gro-uk.definition: A care leaver bursary claimed under the provision.

gro-uk.label: Signed Declaration
gro-uk.definition: A signed document confirming the apprentice's eligibility and consent for the care leavers bursary.

gro-uk.label: Evidence of Payment
gro-uk.definition: Documentation proving that a payment has been made, such as a transaction record or confirmation.

gro-uk.label: Financial System
gro-uk.definition: A provider's internal system used to record and process financial transactions.

gro-uk.label: End-Point Assessment Process
gro-uk.definition: The end-point assessment process that apprentices must be prepared for and understand.

gro-uk.label: Engage EPAO Action
gro-uk.definition: The action of engaging an end-point assessment organisation.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Price Difference
gro-uk.definition: The monetary difference between the total negotiated price of an apprenticeship and the funding band maximum for the standard.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Training
gro-uk.definition: The structured training program undertaken by an apprentice as part of their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Information
gro-uk.definition: Relevant information about the apprentice required for end-point assessment and certification

gro-uk.label: Employment
gro-uk.definition: An employment relationship between an employer and an employee

gro-uk.label: Proxy Employer Role
gro-uk.definition: A role allowing a main provider to act as a proxy employer for the purposes of providing an employer competency statement.

gro-uk.label: Employer Competency Statement
gro-uk.definition: A statement required from an employer confirming the competency of an apprentice.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Service Support
gro-uk.definition: The apprenticeship service support authority that providers must contact for approval and technical details.

gro-uk.label: Approval and Technical Details
gro-uk.definition: The approval to report a change and the technical details for claiming the completion payment.

gro-uk.label: Assessment Action
gro-uk.definition: The action of assessing a learner's competence or knowledge.

gro-uk.label: Integrated Standard
gro-uk.definition: A standard where training and assessment are integrated, forming an exception to the prohibition on training providers assessing their own learners.

gro-uk.label: Awarding Body
gro-uk.definition: Organisation that awards qualifications, including mandatory qualifications in apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Occupation Practitioner
gro-uk.definition: A person from the relevant occupation who participates in the delivery and grading decision of an end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Changing to New Version Rules
gro-uk.definition: The set of rules titled 'Changing to a new version of a standard' referenced in paragraphs 294 to 308.

gro-uk.label: End-Point Assessment Organisation Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of an organisation responsible for conducting end-point assessments for apprenticeship standards.

gro-uk.label: Professional Body
gro-uk.definition: A professional body that may act as an end-point assessment organisation for an integrated degree standard.

gro-uk.label: Integrated Degree Standard
gro-uk.definition: An apprenticeship standard that integrates a degree qualification with on-the-job training and end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Certificate
gro-uk.definition: A certificate awarded to an apprentice upon achieving a mandatory qualification.

gro-uk.label: End-Point Assessment Record
gro-uk.definition: Records and evidence of completion of the end-point assessment, including signed statements and EPAO evidence.

gro-uk.label: Foundation Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: A role representing a foundation apprenticeship programme, distinct from non-foundation apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Training Additional Payment
gro-uk.definition: An additional £1,000 payment towards the additional cost associated with training for eligible apprentices.

gro-uk.label: Employer Incentive Payment
gro-uk.definition: A payment generated when a foundation apprenticeship attracts an employer incentive, as identified on the Skills England website.

gro-uk.label: Education and Skills Funding Agency
gro-uk.definition: The regulatory authority responsible for apprenticeship funding rules in the UK.

gro-uk.label: Days in Learning Aggregate
gro-uk.definition: A calculated resource representing the sum of days in learning with a first employer and days in learning with a new employer, used to determine when subsequent payments are due.

gro-uk.label: Summary of Training Document
gro-uk.definition: A document which evidences the training that the apprentice has undertaken to the point of changing providers.

gro-uk.label: Provider Additional Payment
gro-uk.definition: A payment made to a training provider in addition to standard funding, based on eligibility criteria.

gro-uk.label: Incentive Payment
gro-uk.definition: A payment made to an employer to encourage specific behaviours or outcomes.

gro-uk.label: Local Authority
gro-uk.definition: A local government body responsible for statutory duties including NEET prevention.

gro-uk.label: IAG Support
gro-uk.definition: Information, Advice and Guidance support offered to apprentices.

gro-uk.label: NEET Risk Notification
gro-uk.definition: Statutory duty to notify the relevant local authority when an apprentice is at risk of becoming NEET.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Development Summary
gro-uk.definition: A summary of the knowledge, skills and behaviours that the apprentice has developed and evidenced during their time on their foundation apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Qualification Details
gro-uk.definition: Details of a qualification, or units thereof, achieved in the context of a foundation apprenticeship having a mandatory qualification.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Service
gro-uk.definition: The digital service through which apprenticeship funding is managed and allocated in the UK.

gro-uk.label: New Apprentice Start
gro-uk.definition: A new instance of an individual commencing an apprenticeship programme.

gro-uk.label: Completion Payment
gro-uk.definition: Completion payment is a payment we make to providers when an apprentice completes all their learning and undertakes the end-point assessment (the apprentice does not need to pass). This payment is 20% of either the total negotiated price or the funding band maximum, whichever is lower.

gro-uk.label: Government Body
gro-uk.definition: A public body that is part of the government structure, such as a ministry, department, or agency.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Service Account Data
gro-uk.definition: Data entered into the apprenticeship service account as referenced in UK regulatory provisions.

gro-uk.label: ILR Submission
gro-uk.definition: Information submitted by the provider each month through the Individualised Learner Record (ILR).

gro-uk.label: Non-Levy Paying Employer Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of an employer who does not pay the apprenticeship levy.

gro-uk.label: Reserved Funds
gro-uk.definition: Funds reserved by an employer for the purpose of funding an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Restart Reservation
gro-uk.definition: A reservation that funds an apprenticeship restart where the apprenticeship was previously funded via contracted provision and following redundancy or provider failure.

gro-uk.label: Reservation
gro-uk.definition: A reservation for an apprenticeship, which expires if not used within 3 months of its start date.

gro-uk.label: ILR and Apprenticeship Service
gro-uk.definition: The ILR and the apprenticeship service systems where the agreed price is entered

gro-uk.label: TNP2 Record
gro-uk.definition: A TNP2 record in the ILR system where end-point assessment organisation details are entered

gro-uk.label: ILR Field
gro-uk.definition: A field in the Individualised Learner Record (ILR) that must be left blank until the end-point assessment price is confirmed

gro-uk.label: Funding Band
gro-uk.definition: bands and the maximum of these bands range from £1,500 to £27,000; this is the most that the government will contribute, including amounts that can be taken from a levy-paying employer’s apprenticeship service account. The funding band does not include costs for English and maths, learning support payments or additional payments for young people.

gro-uk.label: TNP Change
gro-uk.definition: A change in either TNP1 or TNP2, requiring a reason and evidence of prior agreement with the employer.

gro-uk.label: Non-Levy Paying Employer
gro-uk.definition: Employers who do not pay the apprenticeship levy, and levy paying employers with insufficient funds, as defined in UK apprenticeship funding regulations.

gro-uk.label: Co-Investment Amount
gro-uk.definition: The relevant amount of the total negotiated price, up to the funding band maximum, towards the cost of apprenticeship training and assessment.

gro-uk.label: Excess Cost Payment
gro-uk.definition: A funding allocation representing the employer's obligation to pay additional costs above the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Co-Investment
gro-uk.definition: Co-investment is where the government shares the cost of training and assessing apprentices with employers. For apprenticeship training that started on or after 1 April 2019, employers (who either do not pay the levy or levy payers who have run out of levy funds) pay 5% towards the cost of apprenticeship training. The government will pay the rest (95%) up to the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Eligible Training Costs
gro-uk.definition: The eligible costs of training, on-programme or end-point assessment, for which an apprentice must not be asked to contribute financially.

gro-uk.label: Contract for Services
gro-uk.definition: A contract between a contractor and a client (e.g. a provider and an employer).

gro-uk.label: Training or Assessment Supply
gro-uk.definition: Supplies of training or end-point assessment as referenced in UK regulatory provisions.

gro-uk.label: VAT
gro-uk.definition: Value Added Tax as referenced in UK regulatory provisions.

gro-uk.label: Co-investment Percentage
gro-uk.definition: This percentage represents the amount of co-investment the employer would have otherwise had to contribute towards the apprenticeship, if funds had not been transferred.

gro-uk.label: Minimal Financial Assistance Exemption
gro-uk.definition: A financial exemption threshold of £315,000 over a rolling 3-year period.

gro-uk.label: Regulator
gro-uk.definition: The regulatory authority to be contacted by providers.

gro-uk.label: Transfer Amount
gro-uk.definition: A funding allocation resource representing the transfer amount that covers eligible training and assessment costs for an apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Levy Sending Employer
gro-uk.definition: An employer that pays the apprenticeship levy and agrees to fund an apprenticeship through a transfer of levy funds.

gro-uk.label: Transferred Funds
gro-uk.definition: Funds transferred for apprenticeship training and assessment payments.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Training and Assessment
gro-uk.definition: The apprenticeship training and/or on-programme assessment associated with an employer's apprenticeship programme.

gro-uk.label: Agreement
gro-uk.definition: A formal agreement document to be completed and signed by the provider, employer, and apprentice regarding KIT/SPLIT days for apprenticeship off-the-job training and/or assessment.

gro-uk.label: Transfer of Levy Funds
gro-uk.definition: The transfer of apprenticeship levy funds from one employer to another to support an apprentice's continued training.

gro-uk.label: Approved Apprenticeship Record
gro-uk.definition: An official record of an approved apprenticeship to which transfer funds can be linked.

gro-uk.label: All Parties
gro-uk.definition: The collective group of all parties involved in the apprenticeship service price confirmation process.

gro-uk.label: Price
gro-uk.definition: The negotiated price with the main provider and end-point assessment organisation.

gro-uk.label: Additional Costs
gro-uk.definition: Costs exceeding the funding band maximum for an apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: APAR
gro-uk.definition: The published Approved Provider and Apprenticeship Register.

gro-uk.label: UKPRN
gro-uk.definition: A UK Provider Reference Number.

gro-uk.label: Level 6 Teacher Apprenticeship Standard
gro-uk.definition: The Level 6 Teacher apprenticeship standard.

gro-uk.label: Funding Higher Risk Policy
gro-uk.definition: The 'Funding higher risk organisations and subcontractors' policy.

gro-uk.label: Single Provider
gro-uk.definition: A single provider that the employer has chosen to route all apprenticeship funding through.

gro-uk.label: Training or On-Programme Assessment
gro-uk.definition: Training or on-programme assessment that must be directly delivered by the provider

gro-uk.label: Employer Apprenticeship Programme
gro-uk.definition: All of the apprentices that a provider has been contracted to deliver training to, at that employer, irrespective of the occupational area, standard or level.

gro-uk.label: Subcontracting Rationale
gro-uk.definition: A rationale for subcontracting in the delivery of apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Service List
gro-uk.definition: A list of all services the provider's organisation will provide to the subcontractor and the associated costs for doing so.

gro-uk.label: Subcontracting Policy
gro-uk.definition: A policy document outlining the provider's approach and rationale for subcontracting.

gro-uk.label: Governance Lead Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of the person charged with overall responsibility for the organisation in the governance structure.

gro-uk.label: Subcontracting Information
gro-uk.definition: Information including the rationale for subcontracting, the services to be provided, and the associated costs, as referred to in paragraphs 224 and 225.

gro-uk.label: Contracting Authority
gro-uk.definition: An organisation subject to public procurement regulations, such as the Public Contracts Regulations 2015.

gro-uk.label: Public Contracts Regulations 2015
gro-uk.definition: The UK statutory instrument that regulates public procurement by contracting authorities.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Training and Assessment
gro-uk.definition: The delivery of apprenticeship training and/or on-programme assessment services.

gro-uk.label: Written Agreement
gro-uk.definition: A written agreement between the main provider and the employer setting out and confirming the delivery of their apprenticeship programme.

gro-uk.label: Subcontractor Funding
gro-uk.definition: The amount of funding that the main provider will pay each subcontractor for their apprenticeship training and/or on-programme assessment contribution.

gro-uk.label: Provider Management Control Entitlement
gro-uk.definition: An entitlement by the provider to exercise management controls over the subcontractor’s activity, including access by auditors appointed by either the provider or by us.

gro-uk.label: Provider Organisation
gro-uk.definition: The provider's organisation that provides services to the subcontractor.

gro-uk.label: Subcontractor Premises
gro-uk.definition: The physical premises of a subcontractor involved in subcontracted delivery.

gro-uk.label: Subcontractor Document
gro-uk.definition: A document related to a subcontractor's subcontracted delivery.

gro-uk.label: Ofsted
gro-uk.definition: The Office for Standards in Education, Children's Services and Skills, a non-ministerial department of the UK government responsible for inspecting educational institutions.

gro-uk.label: Education Inspection Framework
gro-uk.definition: Ofsted's framework for inspecting education providers, setting out the criteria and standards for assessment.

gro-uk.label: Self-Assessment Report
gro-uk.definition: A report produced by a provider evaluating its own performance, incorporating evidence and guiding judgements and grades.

gro-uk.label: Sufficient Evidence
gro-uk.definition: Evidence that is adequate in quantity and quality to allow a provider to assess performance against Ofsted's framework.

gro-uk.label: Subcontract Ending
gro-uk.definition: The condition that a subcontract has ended for any reason.

gro-uk.label: Irregular Financial or Delivery Issue
gro-uk.definition: A condition where evidence of irregular financial or delivery issues arises, including non-delivery of training when funds have been paid, sanctions by an awarding organisation, or allegations of fraud.

gro-uk.label: Legal Advice
gro-uk.definition: Professional legal guidance regarding the incorporation of provisions and terms in subcontracting agreements.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Funding Rules
gro-uk.definition: The set of regulatory rules governing the funding of apprenticeship delivery.

gro-uk.label: High-Quality Delivery
gro-uk.definition: A state where apprenticeship delivery meets the quality standards required by the agreement and funding rules.

gro-uk.label: Safeguarding Enforcement
gro-uk.definition: A state where safeguarding measures are rigorously enforced by the provider.

gro-uk.label: Inconsistency Instance
gro-uk.definition: An instance where the provider's findings are not consistent with the funding rules, expectations, and subcontractor records.

gro-uk.label: Regulatory Authority
gro-uk.definition: The authority referred to as 'us' in the provision, responsible for receiving reports of inconsistencies.

gro-uk.label: Alternative Delivery Arrangement
gro-uk.definition: Alternative delivery arrangements made for each apprentice affected by a subcontractor's change of circumstances

gro-uk.label: Subcontractor Change of Circumstances
gro-uk.definition: A change of circumstances affecting a subcontractor's ability to continue to deliver under a subcontract, including liquidation, administration, key staff leaving, or removal from APAR

gro-uk.label: Exemption Case
gro-uk.definition: A formal submission requesting exemption from the 25% subcontracting threshold for apprenticeship funding.

gro-uk.label: Government Department
gro-uk.definition: A department of the UK government, acting as a regulatory authority in the context of UK-UNIT-00834.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Helpline Contact
gro-uk.definition: Contact details for the apprenticeship helpline, including phone number and website.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Training Costs
gro-uk.definition: Actual costs of delivery of apprenticeship training and on-programme assessment

gro-uk.label: New Subcontractor
gro-uk.definition: A subcontractor identified as new according to the relevant glossary definition.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Delivery
gro-uk.definition: The act of delivering apprenticeship training or services.

gro-uk.label: Monitoring Arrangement
gro-uk.definition: Arrangements established by a provider to monitor the apprenticeship training and on-programme assessment delivered by subcontractors.

gro-uk.label: FJAA
gro-uk.definition: A type of organisation referred to as FJAAs in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Placement Documentation
gro-uk.definition: Documented details of an apprentice's placement, including host employer name and placement duration.

gro-uk.label: Prisoner Apprentice Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of a prisoner who is also an apprentice, as referenced in UK regulatory provisions.

gro-uk.label: Memorandum of Understanding
gro-uk.definition: A completed and signed Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) document.

gro-uk.label: Training Cost
gro-uk.definition: The cost of training and, where applicable, end-point assessment delivered to date.

gro-uk.label: Last Date of Learning
gro-uk.definition: If an apprentice leaves without completing their apprenticeship, the last date of learning, including the apprenticeship programme learning aim, is the date that providers have evidence the apprentice was still in learning for any learning that was part of their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Over-payment
gro-uk.definition: Funds paid in excess of the amount due from an employer's apprenticeship service account or government-employer co-investment.

gro-uk.label: Repay Over-payment
gro-uk.definition: The act of returning over-paid funds to the relevant funding source.

gro-uk.label: Change of Circumstance Over-payment
gro-uk.definition: A condition where a change of circumstance results in over-payment of funds from an employer's apprenticeship service account or government-employer co-investment.

gro-uk.label: Employer Agreement
gro-uk.definition: A contractual or formal agreement between a main provider and an employer.

gro-uk.label: Front-loaded and Block Release Model
gro-uk.definition: Training delivery models where learning is concentrated at the start or in discrete blocks, as defined in the glossary and agreed with the employer.

gro-uk.label: No Planned OTJT Active Learning
gro-uk.definition: A condition where there is no plan for any off-the-job training active learning to take place within a 3 calendar month period.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship State
gro-uk.definition: A condition representing the state of an apprenticeship, such as being on a shorter or foundation apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Payment Delay
gro-uk.definition: The action of delaying a payment.

gro-uk.label: Shorter Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: An apprenticeship where the published typical duration of the standard is less than 12 months.

gro-uk.label: Redundant Apprentice Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of an apprentice whose apprenticeship agreement has been terminated by reason of redundancy.

gro-uk.label: Continued Funding Eligibility
gro-uk.definition: The state of being eligible for continued funding for apprentices made redundant near the end of their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Employment Status Change
gro-uk.definition: A change in the employment status of an apprentice

gro-uk.label: Transfer Funding
gro-uk.definition: A funding arrangement where apprenticeship funds are transferred from one employer to another

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Agreement Termination
gro-uk.definition: The termination of an apprenticeship agreement

gro-uk.label: New Employer
gro-uk.definition: An employer that takes on an apprentice to complete their apprenticeship after a change of employer.

gro-uk.label: New Price
gro-uk.definition: A newly negotiated price for apprenticeship training between the main provider and the new employer.

gro-uk.label: Redundant Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: An apprentice whose apprenticeship agreement has been terminated by reason of redundancy, who on the day of dismissal has completed less than 75% of the apprenticeship practical period and whose remaining training represents a duration of six months or more.

gro-uk.label: Record of Apprenticeship Part-Completion
gro-uk.definition: A document issued to an apprentice upon withdrawal by reason of redundancy, to support them in finding new employment.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Record
gro-uk.definition: A record that must include specific minimum details about an apprentice and their apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Mandatory Qualification Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: A condition that applies when an apprenticeship includes mandatory qualifications.

gro-uk.label: KIT Day
gro-uk.definition: A keeping in touch day designated for an apprentice to continue with apprenticeship training, assessment, or end-point assessment.

gro-uk.label: Statutory Paternal Leave
gro-uk.definition: Statutory paternal leave is a maximum period of 2 weeks.

gro-uk.label: KIT/SPLIT Day Timing Agreement
gro-uk.definition: An agreement by the employer and provider in relation to the timing of KIT / SPLIT days relative to the monthly payments that the provider will continue to receive if a break in learning is not utilised.

gro-uk.label: Minimum Off-the-Job Training Requirement
gro-uk.definition: The regulatory minimum amount of off-the-job training that must be delivered to an apprentice.

gro-uk.label: Maternity/Adoption/Shared Parental Leave
gro-uk.definition: A period of maternity, adoption, or shared parental leave taken by an apprentice.

gro-uk.label: KIT/SPLIT Day
gro-uk.definition: A Keeping in Touch (KIT) or Shared Parental Leave in Touch (SPLIT) day during a leave period.

gro-uk.label: Existing Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: An apprentice who started their apprenticeship in previous funding years and is currently enrolled in a standard.

gro-uk.label: Newer Version of Standard
gro-uk.definition: A revised version of an apprenticeship standard, potentially with new version costs assigned under Skills England's revisions, adjustments and dispensations process.

gro-uk.label: Skills England
gro-uk.definition: The regulatory authority responsible for revisions, adjustments and dispensations to apprenticeship standards and funding rules.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Standard Version
