gro-uk.definition: A specific version of an apprenticeship standard, including its demands and end-point assessment plan requirements.

gro-uk.label: Main Provider and Employer
gro-uk.definition: The main provider and employer as referenced in the regulatory provision.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Agreement and Training Plan
gro-uk.definition: The apprenticeship agreement and training plan documents that must be updated.

gro-uk.label: Apprentice Details
gro-uk.definition: The personal and programme details of an apprentice recorded in the apprenticeship service.

gro-uk.label: Cost and Price Change
gro-uk.definition: The cost and/or price associated with an end-point assessment that may be changed or re-negotiated.

gro-uk.label: Funding Band Difference
gro-uk.definition: The monetary difference between the funding band maximum for the original standard and the total cost.

gro-uk.label: Unique Learner Number Information
gro-uk.definition: Accurate unique learner number (ULN) information required for apprenticeship registration.

gro-uk.label: Systems and Processes
gro-uk.definition: Wider systems and processes required to assure apprentice existence and eligibility.

gro-uk.label: Electronic or Digital Signature
gro-uk.definition: An electronic or digital signature that is held by a provider and must be ensured non-refutable.

gro-uk.label: Self-Declaration
gro-uk.definition: A document in which an apprentice or employer provides details and confirms certain information.

gro-uk.label: Education Funding
gro-uk.definition: Education or education funding that is excluded from the 'no recourse to public funds' condition.

gro-uk.label: 16 to 18-year-old Role
gro-uk.definition: A role held by individuals aged between 16 and 18 years

gro-uk.label: Assessment Organisation
gro-uk.definition: An organisation responsible for conducting assessments within the apprenticeship framework.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Assessment Cost
gro-uk.definition: The cost of the apprenticeship assessment, which must not exceed 20% of the funding band maximum.

gro-uk.label: Contractual Agreement In Place
gro-uk.definition: A state where a contractual agreement has been established between relevant parties.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Assessment Delivery Arrangements
gro-uk.definition: The arrangements for the delivery of ALL elements of apprenticeship assessment.

gro-uk.label: Revised Assessment Plan
gro-uk.definition: The revised assessment plan for apprenticeship assessment.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Assessment Element
gro-uk.definition: The remaining elements of the apprenticeship assessment as outlined in the assessment plan.

gro-uk.label: Learning
gro-uk.definition: The learning content that must be delivered during the practical period of the apprenticeship.

gro-uk.label: Employer and Provider Role
gro-uk.definition: The combined role of employer and provider as referenced in UK regulatory provision UK-UNIT-01185.

gro-uk.label: Assessment Organisation Role
gro-uk.definition: The role of an assessment organisation as referenced in UK regulatory provision UK-UNIT-01185.

gro-uk.label: End-Point Assessment Price
gro-uk.definition: The price agreed for the end-point assessment as entered into TNP2 on the ILR.

gro-uk.label: TNP2 on the ILR
gro-uk.definition: The TNP2 field on the Individualised Learner Record (ILR) where the end-point assessment price is entered.

gro-uk.label: Accelerated Apprenticeship
gro-uk.definition: An accelerated apprenticeship is where the apprentice’s planned duration is shorter (by at least 3 months) than the typical duration of the standard, based on prior learning.

gro-uk.label: Advanced Learner Loan
gro-uk.definition: Loans for individuals aged 19+ to provide financial support towards tuition costs. These loans are paid directly to the college or training organisation. These are not applicable to apprenticeships.

gro-uk.label: Apprenticeship Levy
gro-uk.definition: Apprenticeship levy is a levy on UK employers to raise funds to pay for apprenticeship training and assessment, charged at 0.5% of an employer’s pay bill, with each employer receiving an allowance of £15,000 to offset against their levy payment.

gro-uk.label: Double Funding
gro-uk.definition: Double funding is where multiple funding sources are used for the same activity.

gro-uk.label: Significant Front Loading
gro-uk.definition: Significant front loading is defined as 50% of the planned OTJ hours being delivered in the first 25% of the planned duration.

gro-uk.label: Inducement
gro-uk.definition: Something that persuades or influences someone to do something. For example, if a provider offered extra training, not required for the apprenticeship, to an employer and included this in the total negotiated price. This is not allowed.

gro-uk.label: Minimum Duration
gro-uk.definition: Minimum duration is the minimum length of time an apprentice must spend on training.

gro-uk.label: Onboarding of the Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: Onboarding of the apprentice will include agreeing a price with the employer and developing, agreeing and signing any relevant paperwork to support the apprenticeship, such as the training plan. Onboarding does not include training delivery and therefore does not count towards the off-the-job training policy.

gro-uk.label: Part Time Apprentice
gro-uk.definition: An individual engaged on an apprenticeship who works less than 30 hours per week.

gro-uk.label: Quality Framework for Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agencies
gro-uk.definition: Quality Framework for Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agencies is the framework set out by the Department that includes Quality Indicators to which the Flexi-Job Apprenticeship Agency must adhere, as updated and amended from time to time.

gro-uk.label: Total Negotiated Price
gro-uk.definition: Total negotiated price (TNP) is the price negotiated between an employer and main provider for all the eligible costs of an apprentice’s training and assessment, after relevant prior learning has been taken into account.

gro-uk.label: Withdrawal
gro-uk.definition: Withdrawal is when an apprentice leaves or stops taking part in their apprenticeship before they have completed it.

gro-uk.label: Learning Support Subcontracting Definition
gro-uk.definition: Learning support would only be considered to be subcontracting if the separate legal entity delivering the learning support was also the party delivering the programme of learning.

gro-uk.label: Supporting Provider
gro-uk.definition: A supporting provider is an organisation that is on the ‘supporting provider’ route of the Apprenticeship Provider and Assessment Register (APAR). They may only act as a ‘subcontractor’.

gro-us.label: FAFSA Student Role
gro-us.definition: The role of a student who is an applicant for Title IV aid and must provide consent for FTI access

gro-us.label: FAFSA Contributor Role
gro-us.definition: The role of a contributor to the FAFSA form who must provide consent for FTI access

gro-us.label: FTI Access, Disclosure, and Use
gro-us.definition: Federal Tax Information access, disclosure, and use in evaluating Title IV aid eligibility

gro-us.label: Student
gro-us.definition: A person enrolled in an educational institution who is eligible to apply for federal student aid.

gro-us.label: Contributor
gro-us.definition: Contributor refers to anyone who is required to provide information, consent, and approval, and a signature on the FAFSA form.

gro-us.label: FAFSA Application
gro-us.definition: The Free Application for Federal Student Aid form used to determine eligibility for student financial aid in the United States.

gro-us.label: Consent and Approval
gro-us.definition: The consent and approval required to obtain tax information from the IRS for the FAFSA application.

gro-us.label: Legal Dependent
gro-us.definition: Students who have legal dependents are independent. Legal dependents include children or other people (except a spouse) who meet all the following criteria: They live with the student (or, in the case of children, live apart from the student due to a qualifying temporary absence under IRS code, such as living apart due to college enrollment). They currently receive more than half of their support from the student. They will continue to receive more than half of their support from the student between July 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026.

gro-us.label: Student Role
gro-us.definition: The role of an individual enrolled in an educational program, subject to verification requirements for Pell Grant eligibility.

gro-us.label: Chafee Voucher Eligibility Verification
gro-us.definition: Verification of the student's eligibility for an education and training voucher under the John H. Chafee Foster Care Program under section 477 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 677) is a documented phone call or written statement from a financial aid administrator who documented the student's circumstance in the same or a prior award year.

gro-us.label: Direct Unsubsidized Loan
gro-us.definition: A dependent level Direct Unsubsidized Loan available to students whose parents refuse to support them.

gro-us.label: Financial Aid Administrator
gro-us.definition: A role responsible for reviewing and determining student financial aid eligibility.

gro-us.label: State Financial Aid
gro-us.definition: Financial aid provided by a U.S. state to eligible students, including grants and other assistance programs.

gro-us.label: Free or Reduced-Price School Lunch
gro-us.definition: A school meal program benefit providing free or reduced-price lunches to eligible students.

gro-us.label: U.S. Department of Agriculture
gro-us.definition: The United States Department of Agriculture, a federal executive department responsible for developing and executing federal laws related to farming, forestry, rural economic development, and food.

gro-us.label: Employer Education Benefits
gro-us.definition: Employer education benefits count as other financial assistance (or reduce the cost of attendance) even if they aren't received until the end of the class(es) and are contingent on earning a minimum grade.

gro-us.label: Prepaid Tuition Plan
gro-us.definition: Prepaid tuition plans allow a person to buy tuition credits or certificates, which count as units of attendance. They are an asset of the plan owner, and their worth is the refund value of the credits or certificates.

gro-us.label: Financial Resource
gro-us.definition: A resource representing financial value, such as an aid package or loan proceeds.

gro-us.label: Single Parent
gro-us.definition: A condition of being a single parent

gro-us.label: Not Single Parent
gro-us.definition: A condition of not being a single parent

gro-us.label: Federal Income Tax Return Filing
gro-us.definition: The action of filing a federal income tax return

gro-us.label: AGI Threshold
gro-us.definition: A condition concerning adjusted gross income relative to poverty guidelines

gro-us.label: Means-Tested Benefit Program
gro-us.definition: A Federal benefit program that uses means testing to determine eligibility

gro-us.label: Parents' Available Income
gro-us.definition: Parents' available income is calculated by subtracting certain allowances from the parents' total income. These allowances account for certain nondiscretionary expenses, such as taxes and basic living expenses. Once a minimum level of support has been offset for those expenses, the formula assumes that the remaining income is available for discretionary purposes, including paying for a postsecondary education. The available income can be a negative number.

gro-us.label: Parents Contribution from Assets
gro-us.definition: A calculated amount representing the contribution from the assets of parents of a dependent student, determined by adding cash, savings, checking, time deposits, money market funds, net worth of investments, and adjusted net worth of business and/or investment farm.

gro-us.label: Parents' Contribution
gro-us.definition: The calculated amount representing the portion of parental income and assets considered available to help pay for the student's college education, as determined under the 2025-26 Student Aid Index (SAI) and Pell Grant Eligibility Guide.

gro-us.label: Student Contribution from Income
gro-us.definition: The calculated amount representing a student's contribution from income, determined by multiplying the student's available income by the assessment rate of 50%, which may be a negative number as low as -1,500.

gro-us.label: Contribution from Assets
gro-us.definition: The calculated financial contribution derived from a student's (and spouse's) assets, as determined by the full formula using net worth, discretionary net worth, and asset protection allowance tables.

gro-us.label: Income Allowance Calculation
gro-us.definition: A calculation that sums specific allowances (U.S. income tax paid, payroll tax allowance, income protection allowance, and employment expense allowance) to reduce the student's (and spouse's) total income for the Student Aid Index.

gro-us.label: Student Aid Index
gro-us.definition: The Student Aid Index (SAI) is a calculated value representing a student's financial need for postsecondary education, determined by adding available income and contribution from assets, then applying progressive rates from Table C6 (22% to 47%) as adjusted available income increases.

gro-us.label: Institution Role
gro-us.definition: The role of an institution that uses a verification document and is subject to the obligation to ensure its completeness and signature.

gro-us.label: Subsidized Title IV Aid
gro-us.definition: Federal student aid under Title IV that is subsidized, including Federal Work-Study, for which verification is required.

gro-us.label: Unsubsidized Title IV Aid
gro-us.definition: Federal student aid under Title IV that is unsubsidized, for which verification is not required except as noted.

gro-us.label: School
gro-us.definition: An educational institution that provides instruction and may administer federal student aid programs.

gro-us.label: Verification Information
gro-us.definition: Information provided to students selected for verification, including role explanation, deadlines, consequences, notification methods, and procedures.

gro-us.label: Institution
gro-us.definition: An educational institution subject to the FAFSA Simplification Act provisions.

gro-us.label: Application
gro-us.definition: An application form or submission containing information subject to verification.

gro-us.label: Title IV Aid
gro-us.definition: Federal student financial assistance provided under Title IV of the Higher Education Act.

gro-us.label: Verification Document
gro-us.definition: A document used for verification purposes, which must be signed, completed, and accompanied by relevant tax or alternative documents.

gro-us.label: Statement of Educational Purpose
gro-us.definition: A document certifying the student's identity and that federal student aid will only be used for educational purposes and the cost of attending the school for the 2025-26 year.

gro-us.label: Notary Certification
gro-us.definition: A certification from a notary public that the student appeared before the notary and presented a government-issued photo ID confirming their identity.

gro-us.label: Government-Issued Photo ID
gro-us.definition: A government-issued photo identification document used to confirm identity.

gro-us.label: Notary Public
gro-us.definition: A role of a person authorized to perform certain legal formalities, especially to witness signatures on documents.

gro-us.label: IRS Approval Copy
gro-us.definition: A copy of the IRS's approval of a filing extension beyond the automatic six-month extension.

gro-us.label: W-2 Form Copy
gro-us.definition: A copy of IRS Form W-2 for each source of employment income.

gro-us.label: Signed Statement
gro-us.definition: A signed statement listing sources of income and amounts, including estimated AGI and tax paid if self-employed.

gro-us.label: IRS
gro-us.definition: The Internal Revenue Service, the U.S. federal agency responsible for tax collection and tax law enforcement.

gro-us.label: HCM2 and Reimbursement School
gro-us.definition: An educational institution operating under Heightened Cash Monitoring 2 (HCM2) or Reimbursement payment methods as defined in Volume 4, Chapter 1 of the FSA Handbook.

gro-us.label: Interim Disbursement
gro-us.definition: A disbursement of Title IV funds made on an interim basis before final determination of student eligibility, including completion of verification.

gro-us.label: Pertinent Financial Information
gro-us.definition: Financial information such as spousal income and taxes paid that must be updated to reflect marital status changes.

gro-us.label: Dependent Student
gro-us.definition: A student who is classified as a dependent for financial aid purposes under U.S. regulations.

gro-us.label: Family Size
gro-us.definition: The number of individuals counted in a student's household for financial aid calculation purposes.

gro-us.label: Stepparent Income and Assets
gro-us.definition: The income and assets of a new stepparent that are excluded from the student's financial aid calculation under this exception.

gro-us.label: Pell Grant Recalculation
gro-us.definition: A structural rule defining the recalculation of a Pell Grant when FAFSA data changes, using the corrected valid FAFSA Submission Summary or ISIR.

gro-us.label: Document
gro-us.definition: A written, printed, or electronic record that provides information or evidence.

gro-us.label: Direct Unsubsidized and PLUS Loans
gro-us.definition: Federal student loans including Direct Unsubsidized Loans and Parent PLUS Loans.

gro-us.label: Signature
gro-us.definition: A required signature on worksheets or copies of tax returns that must be collected at the time of verification.

gro-us.label: Verification Deadline
gro-us.definition: The deadline for verification for a given award year, after which signatures cannot be collected.

gro-us.label: Pell Grant Eligibility
gro-us.definition: The state of being eligible to receive a Pell Grant for a given award year.

gro-us.label: Pell Grant Money
gro-us.definition: Financial resources disbursed under the Pell Grant program.

gro-us.label: Verification Documentation
gro-us.definition: Documentation submitted by a student to verify eligibility for aid

gro-us.label: FAFSA Submission Summary
gro-us.definition: A summary of the student's FAFSA submission processed by the Department

gro-us.label: ISIR
gro-us.definition: Institutional Student Information Record, a valid electronic record received by a school.

gro-us.label: Late Disbursement
gro-us.definition: A disbursement of financial aid made after the student's eligibility period has ended

gro-us.label: Department
gro-us.definition: The Department referenced as the authority in the provision.

gro-us.label: Cost of Attendance Component
gro-us.definition: Components of a student's cost of attendance or data determining a student's student aid index.

gro-us.label: Special Circumstances
gro-us.definition: Special Circumstances refer to the financial situations (loss of a job, etc.) that justify an aid administrator adjusting data elements in the COA or in the SAI calculation.

gro-us.label: Professional Judgment Decision Reason
gro-us.definition: The documented rationale for an institution's decision to approve or deny a request for professional judgment and any subsequent adjustments.

gro-us.label: Financial Aid Administrator
gro-us.definition: A role responsible for administering financial aid at an institution, including making dependency override determinations.

gro-us.label: Income Earned from Work
gro-us.definition: Income earned from work for an applicant, student, parent, or spouse.

gro-us.label: Unemployment Benefits Documentation
gro-us.definition: Paper or electronic documentation of receipt of unemployment benefits or confirmation of application submission.

gro-us.label: Regulatory Authority Agent
gro-us.definition: An agent acting as a regulatory authority within the US jurisdiction.

gro-us.label: Direct Loan Funds
gro-us.definition: Funds provided under the Direct Loan program.

gro-us.label: Documentation Item
gro-us.definition: An item that may be included in documentation, such as an interview record, court order, or official documentation.

gro-us.label: Provisional Independent Status
gro-us.definition: A temporary status assigned to a student who claims unusual circumstances and does not provide parental data on the FAFSA, pending further review.

gro-us.label: Provisional SAI Calculation
gro-us.definition: A provisional Student Aid Index calculation generated when a student applies without parental data under unusual circumstances.

gro-us.label: Dependent Student Without Parental Support
gro-us.definition: A role held by dependent students whose parents refuse to support them financially or refuse to complete the FAFSA.

gro-us.label: Independence Determination Request
gro-us.definition: A request made by a student for a determination of independence under the FAFSA Simplification Act.

gro-us.label: Conflicting Information
gro-us.definition: Information from any source that contradicts or is inconsistent with other data affecting a student's eligibility for federal student aid.

gro-us.label: Graduate/Professional Student Role
gro-us.definition: The role of a student who is a graduate or professional student, as defined for Title IV aid purposes.

gro-us.label: Pell Grant
gro-us.definition: A Pell Grant, a form of undergraduate federal student aid.

gro-us.label: Undergraduate Aid
gro-us.definition: Other forms of undergraduate federal student aid, excluding Pell Grants.

gro-us.label: Minimum Pell Grant
gro-us.definition: A grant resource representing the Minimum Pell Grant under HEA Sec. 474-479.

gro-us.label: Student Not Qualifying for Max/Calc Pell
gro-us.definition: A student role for individuals who do not qualify for a Maximum Pell Grant or a calculated Pell Grant because their SAI is too high.

gro-us.label: FSEOG Funds
gro-us.definition: Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant funds.

gro-us.label: Dependency Override
gro-us.definition: A determination by a financial aid administrator that a student is independent despite not meeting the standard criteria, based on unusual circumstances.
